title: Adi-lila, chapter 7. Setting Forth the Account of the Pañca-tattva
html:
“Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta”
Ādi-līlā
Chapter 7
Setting Forth the Account of the Pañca-tattva
(English translation from the Bengali, following the Gauḍīya Maṭha edition and the Anubhāṣya, 2026)

অগত্যেকগতিং নত্বা হীনার্থাধিকসাধকম্ ৷
শ্রীচৈতন্যং লিখ্যতেঽস্য প্রেমভক্তিবদান্যতা ॥ ১ ॥

agaty-eka-gatiṁ natvā
of the shelterless the only shelter having bowed
hīnārthādhika-sādhakam
to the deprived the highest who grants
śrī-caitanyaṁ likhyate ’sya
to Śrī Caitanya is written His
prema-bhakti-vadānyatā
in giving prema-bhakti magnanimity

1I bow to Śrī Caitanya, the only refuge of those who have no other refuge, who gives the highest treasure to those bereft of every good. Now I write of the magnanimity with which He bestows love and devotion for Kṛṣṇa.1

জয় জয় মহাপ্রভু শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য ৷
তাঁহার চরণাশ্রিত সেই বড় ধন্য ॥ ২ ॥

jaya jaya mahāprabhu śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya
glory glory to Mahāprabhu Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya
tām̐hāra caraṇāśrita sei baḍa dhanya
His at the feet sheltered he greatly blessed

2Glory, glory to Mahāprabhu Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya! Whoever takes shelter at His feet is truly blessed.

পূর্ব্বে গুর্ব্বাদি ছয় তত্ত্বে কৈল নমস্কার ৷
গুরুতত্ত্ব কহিয়াছি, এবে পাঁচের বিচার ॥ ৩ ॥

pūrve gurvādi chaya tattve kaila namaskāra
earlier the guru and the rest six to the truths I made obeisance
guru-tattva kahiyāchi, ebe pām̐cera vicāra
the truth of the guru I have told now of the five the consideration

3At the beginning I offered obeisance to the six truths, headed by the guru. I have spoken of the truth of the guru; now I shall consider the other five.2

পঞ্চতত্ত্ব অবতীর্ণ চৈতন্যের সঙ্গে ৷
পঞ্চতত্ত্ব লঞা করেন সংকীর্ত্তন-রঙ্গে ॥ ৪ ॥

pañca-tattva avatīrṇa caitanyera saṅge
the five truths descended Caitanya with
pañca-tattva lañā karena saṅkīrtana-raṅge
the five truths taking He performs of saṅkīrtana in the joy

4The five truths descended together with Śrī Caitanya, and with them He delights in saṅkīrtana.

পঞ্চতত্ত্ব — এক-বস্তু, নাহি কিছু ভেদ ৷
রস আস্বাদিতে তত্ত্ব বিবিধ বিভেদ ॥ ৫ ॥

pañca-tattva — eka-vastu, nāhi kichu bheda
the five truths one substance there is not any difference
rasa āsvādite tattva vividha vibheda
rasa to taste the truth manifold distinctions

5The five truths are one substance; there is no difference between them at all. Yet to taste rasa, the one truth appears in different forms.3

পঞ্চতত্ত্বাত্মকং কৃষ্ণং ভক্তরূপস্বরূপকম্ ৷
ভক্তাবতারং ভক্তাখ্যং নমামি ভক্তশক্তিকম্ ॥ ৬ ॥

pañca-tattvātmakaṁ kṛṣṇaṁ
of five truths composed Kṛṣṇa
bhakta-rūpa-svarūpakam
devotee in form devotee in essence
bhaktāvatāraṁ bhaktākhyaṁ
the devotee-avatāra called a devotee
namāmi bhakta-śaktikam
I bow to the devotional potency

6“I bow to Kṛṣṇa, who is manifest as five truths — the Pañca-tattva: as a devotee in form and a devotee in essence, as the incarnation of a devotee, as the one called a devotee, and as the potency of devotion.” (Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī)4

স্বয়ং ভগবান্ কৃষ্ণ একলে ঈশ্বর ৷
অদ্বিতীয়, নন্দাত্মজ, রসিক-শেখর ॥ ৭ ॥

svayaṁ bhagavān kṛṣṇa ekale īśvara
Himself Bhagavān Kṛṣṇa the one Lord
advitīya, nandātmaja, rasika-śekhara
without a second Nanda’s son of rasikas the crown

7Kṛṣṇa is Bhagavān Himself, the one Lord of all. He has no equal; He is the son of Nanda and the crown of all who relish rasa.

রাসাদি-বিলাসী, ব্রজললনা-নাগর ৷
আর যত সব দেখ, — তাঁর পরিকর ॥ ৮ ॥

rāsādi-vilāsī, vrajalalanā-nāgara
of the rāsa and other pastimes the enjoyer of the maidens of Vraja the lover
āra yata saba dekha, — tām̐ra parikara
others as many all you see His associates

8He enjoys the rāsa dance and His other pastimes and is the beloved of the maidens of Vraja; all the others you see are His associates.

সেই কৃষ্ণ অবতীর্ণ শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য ৷
সেই পরিকরগণ সঙ্গে সব ধন্য ॥ ৯ ॥

sei kṛṣṇa avatīrṇa śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya
that Kṛṣṇa has descended as Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya
sei parikara-gaṇa saṅge saba dhanya
those associates with Him all blessed

9That same Kṛṣṇa has descended as Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, and with Him have come all those associates, every one of them blessed.

একলা ঈশ্বর-তত্ত্ব চৈতন্য-ঈশ্বর ৷
ভক্তভাবময় তাঁর শুদ্ধ কলেবর ॥ ১০ ॥

ekalā īśvara-tattva caitanya-īśvara
alone the Lord-truth Caitanya the Lord
bhakta-bhāvamaya tām̐ra śuddha kalevara
of a devotee’s sentiment full His pure body

10Lord Caitanya alone is the Supreme Lord, yet His pure, spiritual body is filled with the sentiment of a devotee.5

কৃষ্ণমাধুর্য্যের এক অদ্ভুত স্বভাব ৷
আপনা আস্বাদিতে কৃষ্ণ করে ভক্তভাব ॥ ১১ ॥

kṛṣṇa-mādhuryera eka adbhuta svabhāva
of Kṛṣṇa’s sweetness one wondrous property
āpanā āsvādite kṛṣṇa kare bhakta-bhāva
Himself to taste Kṛṣṇa takes on a devotee’s sentiment

11Kṛṣṇa’s sweetness has one wondrous property: to taste Himself, He takes on the sentiment of His own devotee.6

ইথে ভক্তভাব ধরে চৈতন্য গোসাঞি ৷
‘ভক্তস্বরূপ’ তাঁর নিত্যানন্দ-ভাই ॥ ১২ ॥

ithe bhakta-bhāva dhare caitanya gosāñi
therefore a devotee’s sentiment takes Caitanya Gosāñi
‘bhakta-svarūpa’ tām̐ra nityānanda-bhāi
‘devotee in essence’ His Nityānanda the brother

12That is why Caitanya Gosāñi appears in the mood of a devotee, and His brother Nityānanda is the devotee in essence (bhakta-svarūpa).

‘ভক্ত-অবতার’ তাঁর আচার্য্য-গোসাঞি ৷
এই তিন তত্ত্ব সবে প্রভু করি’ গাই ॥ ১৩ ॥

‘bhakta-avatāra’ tām̐ra ācārya-gosāñi
‘the devotee-avatāra’ His the Ācārya Gosāñi
ei tina tattva sabe prabhu kari’ gāi
these three truths all as Lord holding we sing

13Advaita Ācārya is His incarnation as a devotee (bhakta-avatāra). These three truths we all glorify as the Lord — as Prabhu.

এক মহাপ্রভু, আর প্রভু দুইজন ৷
দুই প্রভু সেবে মহাপ্রভুর চরণ ॥ ১৪ ॥

eka mahāprabhu, āra prabhu duijana
one Mahāprabhu and Prabhus two
dui prabhu seve mahāprabhura caraṇa
the two Prabhus serve Mahāprabhu’s feet

14One is Mahāprabhu, and the other two are Prabhus; the two Prabhus serve the feet of Mahāprabhu.

এই তিন তত্ত্ব, — ‘সর্ব্বারাধ্য’ করি’ মানি ৷
চতুর্থ যে ভক্ততত্ত্ব — ‘আরাধক’ করি’ জানি ॥ ১৫ ॥

ei tina tattva, — ‘sarvārādhya’ kari’ māni
these three truths ‘worshipable by all’ as we accept
caturtha ye bhakta-tattva — ‘ārādhaka’ kari’ jāni
the fourth which the devotee-truth ‘worshipper’ as we know

15These three truths we accept as worshipable by all; the fourth, the truth of the devotee, we know as the worshipper.7

শ্রীবাসাদি যত কোটি কোটি ভক্তগণ ৷
‘শুদ্ধভক্ত’-তত্ত্বমধ্যে তাঁ-সবার গণন ॥ ১৬ ॥

śrīvāsādi yata koṭi koṭi bhakta-gaṇa
Śrīvāsa and others all millions millions devotees
‘śuddha-bhakta’-tattva-madhye tām̐-sabāra gaṇana
‘pure devotee’-truth within of them all the counting

16The countless millions of devotees headed by Śrīvāsa are all counted among the pure devotees (śuddha-bhakta).

গদাধর-পণ্ডিতাদি প্রভুর ‘শক্তি’-অবতার ৷
‘অন্তরঙ্গ-ভক্ত’ করি’ গণন যাঁহার ॥ ১৭ ॥

gadādhara-paṇḍitādi prabhura ‘śakti’-avatāra
Gadādhara Paṇḍita and others the Lord’s ‘potency’-avatāras
‘antaraṅga-bhakta’ kari’ gaṇana yām̐hāra
‘intimate devotees’ as counting of whom

17Gadādhara Paṇḍita and others are incarnations of the Lord’s potency (śakti); they are counted as His intimate devotees.8

যাঁ-সবা লঞা প্রভুর নিত্য বিহার ৷
যাঁ-সবা লঞা প্রভুর কীর্ত্তন-প্রচার ॥ ১৮ ॥

যাঁ-সবা লঞা করেন প্রেম আস্বাদন ৷
যাঁ-সবা লঞা দান করে প্রেমধন ॥ ১৯ ॥

yām̐-sabā lañā prabhura nitya vihāra
with whom all taking the Lord’s eternal pastimes
yām̐-sabā lañā prabhura kīrtana-pracāra
with whom all taking the Lord’s of kīrtana spreading
yām̐-sabā lañā karena prema āsvādana
with whom all taking He does of prema tasting
yām̐-sabā lañā dāna kare prema-dhana
with whom all taking giving He makes prema’s treasure

18–19With them the Lord enjoys His eternal pastimes, with them He spreads the kīrtana, with them He tastes prema, and with them He gives away the treasure of prema.9

সেই পঞ্চতত্ত্ব মিলি’ পৃথিবী আসিয়া ৷
পূর্ব্ব-প্রেমভাণ্ডারের মুদ্রা উঘাড়িয়া ॥ ২০ ॥

পাঁচে মিলি’ লুটে প্রেম, করে আস্বাদন ৷
যত যত পিয়ে, তৃষ্ণা বাড়ে অনুক্ষণ ॥ ২১ ॥

sei pañca-tattva mili’ pṛthivī āsiyā
those five truths together to the earth coming
pūrva-premabhāṇḍārera mudrā ughāḍiyā
of the ancient storehouse of prema the seal breaking open
pām̐ce mili’ luṭe prema, kare āsvādana
the five together plunder prema do tasting
yata yata piye, tṛṣṇā bāḍe anukṣaṇa
as much as much they drink thirst grows every moment

20–21Coming to earth together, the five truths broke the seal of the ancient storehouse of prema. Together they plunder that love and taste it, and the more they drink, the more their thirst grows at every moment.10

পুনঃ পুনঃ পিয়াইয়া হয় মহামত্ত ৷
নাচে, কান্দে, হাসে, গায়, যৈছে মদমত্ত ॥ ২২ ॥

punaḥ punaḥ piyāiyā haya mahāmatta
again again giving to drink become greatly maddened
nāce, kānde, hāse, gāya, yaiche mada-matta
they dance weep laugh sing like the intoxicated

22Again and again they give it to others to drink and grow wild with love; they dance, weep, laugh and sing as though intoxicated.

পাত্রাপাত্র-বিচার নাহি, নাহি স্থানাস্থান ৷
যেই যাঁহা পায়, তাঁহা করে প্রেমদান ॥ ২৩ ॥

pātrāpātra-vicāra nāhi, nāhi sthānāsthāna
fit and unfit consideration there is not there is not proper place and improper
yei yām̐hā pāya, tām̐hā kare prema-dāna
whoever wherever is found there they make of prema the gift

23They make no distinction between the fit and the unfit, nor between a proper place and an improper one: wherever they find anyone, there they give prema.

লুটিয়া, খাইয়া, দিয়া, ভাণ্ডার উজাড়ে ৷
আশ্চর্য্য ভাণ্ডার, প্রেম শতগুণ বাড়ে ॥ ২৪ ॥

luṭiyā, khāiyā, diyā, bhāṇḍāra ujāḍe
plundering eating giving the storehouse they empty
āścarya bhāṇḍāra, prema śata-guṇa bāḍe
wondrous storehouse prema a hundredfold grows

24Plundering, tasting and giving, they empty the storehouse; yet so wondrous is this storehouse that the prema in it grows a hundredfold.

উছলিল প্রেমবন্যা চৌদিকে বেড়ায় ৷
স্ত্রী, বৃদ্ধ, বালক, যুবা, সবারে ডুবায় ॥ ২৫ ॥

uchalila prema-vanyā caudike veḍāya
surged of prema the flood on all sides spreads
strī, vṛddha, bālaka, yuvā, sabāre ḍubāya
women old men boys youths all it drowns

25The flood of prema surged and spread on every side, drowning everyone — women and old men, boys and youths.

সজ্জন, দুর্জ্জন, পঙ্গু, জড়, অন্ধগণ ৷
প্রেমবন্যায় ডুবাইল জগতের জন ॥ ২৬ ॥

saj-jana, durjana, paṅgu, jaḍa, andha-gaṇa
the good the wicked the lame the dull the blind
prema-vanyāya ḍubāila jagatera jana
in the flood of prema drowned of the world the people

26The good and the wicked, the lame, the dull and the blind — the flood of prema engulfed all the people of the world.

জগৎ ডুবিল, জীবের হইল বীজ নাশ ৷
তাহা দেখি’ পাঁচ জনের পরম উল্লাস ॥ ২৭ ॥

jagat ḍubila, jīvera haila bīja nāśa
the world drowned of the jīvas became the seed destroyed
tāhā dekhi’ pām̐ca janera parama ullāsa
that seeing of the five persons supreme joy

27The world was drowned, and the seed of the jīvas’ bondage was destroyed. Seeing this, the five felt the highest joy.11

যত যত প্রেমবৃষ্টি করে পঞ্চজন ৷
তত তত বাড়ে জল, ব্যাপে ত্রিভুবন ॥ ২৮ ॥

yata yata prema-vṛṣṭi kare pañca-jana
as much as much rain of prema make the five persons
tata tata bāḍe jala, vyāpe tri-bhuvana
so much so much rises the water pervades the three worlds

28The more the five pour down the rain of prema, the higher the waters rise, until they fill the three worlds.

মায়াবাদী, কর্ম্মনিষ্ঠ, কুতার্কিকগণ ৷
নিন্দক, পাষণ্ডী, যত পড়ুয়া অধম ॥ ২৯ ॥

সেই সব মহাদক্ষ ধাঞা পলাইল ৷
সেই বন্যা তা-সবারে ছুঁইতে নারিল ॥ ৩০ ॥

māyāvādī, karma-niṣṭha, kutārkika-gaṇa
Māyāvādīs those devoted to karma the false logicians
nindaka, pāṣaṇḍī, yata paḍuyā adhama
blasphemers pāṣaṇḍīs all students the lowest
sei saba mahādakṣa dhāñā palāila
they all very clever running fled
sei vanyā tā-sabāre chum̐ite nārila
that flood them all to touch could not

29–30But the Māyāvādīs, those devoted to fruitive work, the false logicians, the blasphemers, the pāṣaṇḍīs and the lowest of students — all these, being very clever, ran away, and the flood could not touch them.12

তাহা দেখি’ মহাপ্রভু করেন চিন্তন ৷
জগৎ ডুবাইতে আমি করিলুঁ যতন ॥ ৩১ ॥

কেহ কেহ এড়াইল, প্রতিজ্ঞা হইল ভঙ্গ ৷
তা-সবা ডুবাইতে পাতিব কিছু রঙ্গ ॥ ৩২ ॥

tāhā dekhi’ mahāprabhu karena cintana
that seeing Mahāprabhu makes reflection
jagat ḍubāite āmi karilum̐ yatana
the world to drown I made effort
keha keha eḍāila, pratijñā haila bhaṅga
some some escaped the vow became broken
tā-sabā ḍubāite pātiba kichu raṅga
them all to drown I shall set some play

31–32Seeing this, Mahāprabhu reflected: “I tried to drown the whole world, but some have escaped, and My vow has been broken. To drown them too, I shall devise a playful ruse.”

এত বলি’ মনে কিছু করিয়া বিচার ৷
সন্ন্যাস-আশ্রম প্রভু কৈলা অঙ্গীকার ॥ ৩৩ ॥

eta bali’ mane kichu kariyā vicāra
thus saying in the mind some making deliberation
sannyāsa-āśrama prabhu kailā aṅgīkāra
the sannyāsa order the Lord made acceptance

33Saying this and deliberating within Himself, the Lord accepted the order of sannyāsa.

চব্বিশ বৎসর ছিলা গৃহস্থ-আশ্রমে ৷
পঞ্চবিংশতি বর্ষে কৈল যতিধর্ম্মে ॥ ৩৪ ॥

cabbiśa vatsara chilā gṛhastha-āśrame
twenty-four years He remained in the householder order
pañca-viṁśati varṣe kaila yati-dharme
in the twenty-fifth year He took to the renunciant’s dharma

34For twenty-four years He lived as a householder; in His twenty-fifth year He took up the dharma of a renunciant.13

সন্ন্যাস করিয়া প্রভু কৈলা আকর্ষণ ৷
যতেক পালাঞাছিল তার্কিকাদি গণ ॥ ৩৫ ॥

sannyāsa kariyā prabhu kailā ākarṣaṇa
sannyāsa having taken the Lord made attraction
yateka pālāñāchila tārkikādi gaṇa
all who had fled the logicians and the rest

35Having taken sannyāsa, the Lord drew to Himself all who had fled — the logicians and the rest.

পড়ুয়া, পাষণ্ডী, কর্ম্মী, নিন্দকাদি যত ৷
তারা আসি’ প্রভু-পায় হয় অবনত ॥ ৩৬ ॥

paḍuyā, pāṣaṇḍī, karmī, nindakādi yata
students pāṣaṇḍīs karmīs blasphemers and others all
tārā āsi’ prabhu-pāya haya avanata
they coming at the Lord’s feet become bowed down

36Students, pāṣaṇḍīs, karmīs, blasphemers and all the others came and bowed down at the Lord’s feet.

অপরাধ ক্ষমাইল, ডুবিল প্রেমজলে ৷
কেবা এড়াইবে প্রভুর প্রেম-মহাজালে ॥ ৩৭ ॥

aparādha kṣamāila, ḍubila prema-jale
offences He forgave they sank in the waters of prema
kebā eḍāibe prabhura prema-mahājāle
who will escape the Lord’s in the great net of prema

37He forgave their offences, and they sank into the waters of prema. Who can escape the Lord’s great net of love?

সবা নিস্তারিতে প্রভু কৃপা-অবতার ৷
সবা নিস্তারিতে করে চাতুরী অপার ॥ ৩৮ ॥

sabā nistārite prabhu kṛpā-avatāra
all to deliver the Lord the avatāra of mercy
sabā nistārite kare cāturī apāra
all to deliver He uses stratagems boundless

38The Lord is the avatāra of mercy who came to deliver everyone, and to that end He devises countless stratagems.

তবে নিজ ভক্ত কৈল যত ম্লেচ্ছ আদি ৷
সবে এড়াইল মাত্র কাশীর মায়াবাদী ॥ ৩৯ ॥

tabe nija bhakta kaila yata mleccha ādi
then His own devotees He made all mlecchas and others
sabe eḍāila mātra kāśīra māyāvādī
all escaped only of Kāśī the Māyāvādīs

39He made His devotees of all — even the mlecchas and others; only the Māyāvādīs of Kāśī escaped.

বৃন্দাবন যাইতে প্রভু রহিলা কাশীতে ৷
মায়াবাদিগণ তাঁরে লাগিলা নিন্দিতে ॥ ৪০ ॥

vṛndāvana yāite prabhu rahilā kāśīte
to Vṛndāvana going the Lord stayed in Kāśī
māyāvādi-gaṇa tām̐re lāgilā nindite
the Māyāvādīs Him began to blaspheme

40On His way to Vṛndāvana the Lord stayed in Kāśī, and the Māyāvādīs began to blaspheme Him:

সন্ন্যাসী হইয়া করেন গায়ন, নাচন ৷
না করে বেদান্ত শ্রবণ, করে সংকীর্ত্তন ॥ ৪১ ॥

sannyāsī haiyā karena gāyana, nācana
a sannyāsī being He does singing dancing
nā kare vedānta śravaṇa, kare saṅkīrtana
not does of Vedānta hearing does saṅkīrtana

41“Though a sannyāsī, He sings and dances. He does not hear Vedānta, but performs saṅkīrtana.14

মূর্খ সন্ন্যাসী নিজ-ধর্ম্ম নাহি জানে ৷
ভাবুক হইয়া ফেরে ভাবুকের সনে ॥ ৪২ ॥

mūrkha sannyāsī nija-dharma nāhi jāne
a foolish sannyāsī his own dharma not knows
bhāvuka haiyā phere bhāvukera sane
sentimental being He wanders with the sentimentalists together

42This foolish sannyāsī does not know His own dharma; a sentimentalist Himself, He wanders about with sentimentalists.”

এ সব শুনিয়া প্রভু হাসে মনে মনে ৷
উপেক্ষা করিয়া কারো না কৈল সম্ভাষণে ॥ ৪৩ ॥

e saba śuniyā prabhu hāse mane mane
this all hearing the Lord smiles in the mind in the mind
upekṣā kariyā kāro nā kaila sambhāṣaṇe
disregard making to anyone not made conversation

43Hearing all this, the Lord smiled within, and, paying no heed, He spoke with none of them.

উপেক্ষা করিয়া কৈল মথুরা গমন ৷
মথুরা দেখিয়া পুনঃ কৈল আগমন ॥ ৪৪ ॥

upekṣā kariyā kaila mathurā gamana
disregard making He made to Mathurā going
mathurā dekhiyā punaḥ kaila āgamana
Mathurā having seen again He made return

44Disregarding them, He went on to Mathurā, and after seeing it He came back again.

কাশীতে লেখক শূদ্র-শ্রীচন্দ্রশেখর ৷
তাঁর ঘরে রহিলা প্রভু স্বতন্ত্র ঈশ্বর ॥ ৪৫ ॥

kāśīte lekhaka śūdra-śrīcandraśekhara
in Kāśī the scribe the śūdra Śrī Candraśekhara
tām̐ra ghare rahilā prabhu svatantra īśvara
his in the house stayed the Lord the independent Īśvara

45In Kāśī lived the scribe Śrī Candraśekhara, a śūdra, and the Lord, supremely independent, stayed in his house.15

তপন-মিশ্রের ঘরে ভিক্ষা-নির্ব্বাহণ ৷
সন্ন্যাসীর সঙ্গে নাহি মানে নিমন্ত্রণ ॥ ৪৬ ॥

tapana-miśrera ghare bhikṣā-nirvāhaṇa
of Tapana Miśra in the house alms taking
sannyāsīra saṅge nāhi māne nimantraṇa
of sannyāsīs in company not accepts invitation

46He took His meals at the house of Tapana Miśra and accepted no invitation in the company of the sannyāsīs.

সনাতন গোসাঞি আসি’ তাঁহাই মিলিলা ৷
তাঁর শিক্ষা লাগি’ প্রভু দু-মাস রহিলা ॥ ৪৭ ॥

sanātana gosāñi āsi’ tām̐hāi mililā
Sanātana Gosāñi coming there met
tām̐ra śikṣā lāgi’ prabhu du-māsa rahilā
his instruction for the sake of the Lord two months stayed

47Sanātana Gosāñi came and met Him there, and to instruct him the Lord stayed two months.

তাঁরে শিক্ষাইল সব বৈষ্ণবের ধর্ম্ম ৷
শ্রীভাগবত-আদি শাস্ত্রের যত গূঢ় মর্ম্ম ॥ ৪৮ ॥

tām̐re śikṣāila saba vaiṣṇavera dharma
him He taught all of the Vaiṣṇavas the dharma
śrī bhāgavata-ādi śāstrera yata gūḍha marma
Śrī Bhāgavata and other of the scriptures all secret heart

48He taught him the whole dharma of the Vaiṣṇavas and all the hidden heart of the Bhāgavata and the other scriptures.

ইতিমধ্যে চন্দ্রশেখর, মিশ্র-তপন ৷
দুঃখী হঞা প্রভু-পায় কৈল নিবেদন ॥ ৪৯ ॥

itimadhye candraśekhara, miśra-tapana
meanwhile Candraśekhara Miśra Tapana
duḥkhī hañā prabhu-pāya kaila nivedana
grieved being at the Lord’s feet made petition

49Meanwhile Candraśekhara and Tapana Miśra, deeply grieved, came to the Lord’s feet with a petition:

কতেক শুনিব প্রভু তোমার নিন্দন!
না পারি সহিতে, এবে ছাড়িব জীবন ॥ ৫০ ॥

kateka śuniba prabhu tomāra nindana!
how much shall we hear O Lord of You the blasphemy
nā pāri sahite, ebe chāḍiba jīvana
not we can bear now we shall give up life

50“How much longer must we hear You blasphemed, O Lord? We cannot bear it; we would rather give up our lives.

তোমাকে নিন্দয়ে যত সন্ন্যাসীর গণ ৷
শুনিতে না পারি, ফাটে হৃদয়-শ্রবণ ॥ ৫১ ॥

tomāke nindaye yata sannyāsīra gaṇa
You blaspheme all of sannyāsīs the company
śunite nā pāri, phāṭe hṛdaya-śravaṇa
to hear not we can bursts heart and ears

51All the sannyāsīs revile You, and we cannot listen to it: our hearts and ears are bursting.”

ইহা শুনি’ রহে প্রভু ঈষৎ হাসিয়া ৷
সেইকালে এক বিপ্র মিলিল আসিয়া ॥ ৫২ ॥

ihā śuni’ rahe prabhu īṣat hāsiyā
this hearing remains the Lord slightly smiling
sei kāle eka vipra milila āsiyā
at that time one brāhmaṇa met coming

52Hearing this, the Lord only smiled a little. Just then a brāhmaṇa came to meet Him.

আসি’ নিবেদন করে চরণে ধরিয়া ৷
এক বস্তু মাগোঁ, দেহ, প্রসন্ন হইয়া ॥ ৫৩ ॥

āsi’ nivedana kare caraṇe dhariyā
coming petition makes the feet clasping
eka vastu māgom̐, deha, prasanna haiyā
one thing I beg give pleased being

53He came and, clasping the Lord’s feet, made his petition: “I beg one thing of You; be pleased and grant it.

সকল সন্ন্যাসী মুঞি কৈনু নিমন্ত্রণ ৷
তুমি যদি আইস, পূর্ণ হয় মোর মন ॥ ৫৪ ॥

sakala sannyāsī muñi kainu nimantraṇa
all sannyāsīs I have made invitation
tumi yadi āisa, pūrṇa haya mora mana
You if come fulfilled becomes my heart

54I have invited all the sannyāsīs; if You come too, my heart’s desire will be fulfilled.

না যাহ সন্ন্যাসী-গোষ্ঠী, ইহা আমি জানি ৷
মোরে অনুগ্রহ কর নিমন্ত্রণ মানি’ ॥ ৫৫ ॥

nā yāha sannyāsī-goṣṭhī, ihā āmi jāni
not You go sannyāsī-gatherings this I know
more anugraha kara nimantraṇa māni’
to me mercy show the invitation accepting

55I know that You do not go to gatherings of sannyāsīs; yet be merciful to me and accept my invitation.”

প্রভু হাসি’ নিমন্ত্রণ কৈল অঙ্গীকার ৷
সন্ন্যাসীরে কৃপা লাগি’ এ ভঙ্গী তাঁহার ॥ ৫৬ ॥

prabhu hāsi’ nimantraṇa kaila aṅgīkāra
the Lord smiling the invitation made acceptance
sannyāsīre kṛpā lāgi’ e bhaṅgī tām̐hāra
to the sannyāsīs mercy for the sake of this gesture His

56Smiling, the Lord accepted the invitation; He made this gesture to show mercy to the sannyāsīs.

সে বিপ্র জানেন, প্রভু না যা’ন কা’র ঘরে ৷
তাঁহার প্রেরণায় তাঁরে অত্যাগ্রহ করে ॥ ৫৭ ॥

se vipra jānena, prabhu nā yā’na kā’ra ghare
that brāhmaṇa knows the Lord not goes to anyone’s house
tām̐hāra preraṇāya tām̐re atyāgraha kare
by His inspiration Him great insistence makes

57The brāhmaṇa knew that the Lord does not go to anyone’s house, but, inspired by the Lord Himself, he pressed Him with great insistence.16

আর দিনে গেলা প্রভু সে বিপ্র-ভবনে ৷
দেখিলেন, বসিয়াছেন সন্ন্যাসীর গণে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

āra dine gelā prabhu se vipra-bhavane
on the next day went the Lord that brāhmaṇa’s house
dekhilena, vasiyāchena sannyāsīra gaṇe
He saw are seated of sannyāsīs the company

58The next day the Lord went to the brāhmaṇa’s house and saw the sannyāsīs all seated there.

সবা নমস্করি’ গেলা পাদ-প্রক্ষালনে ৷
পাদ প্রক্ষালিয়া বসিল সেই স্থানে ॥ ৫৯ ॥

sabā namaskari’ gelā pāda-prakṣālane
to all bowing He went to wash the feet
pāda prakṣāliyā vasila sei sthāne
the feet having washed sat in that place

59Bowing to them all, He went to wash His feet, and when He had washed them He sat down in that very place.

বসিয়া করিলা কিছু ঐশ্বর্য্য প্রকাশ ৷
মহাতেজোময় বপু কোটীসূর্য্যাভাস ॥ ৬০ ॥

vasiyā karilā kichu aiśvarya prakāśa
sitting He made some of majesty display
mahātejomaya vapu koṭī-sūryābhāsa
greatly effulgent body of millions of suns the splendour

60As He sat there, He revealed a little of His majesty: His body shone with great effulgence, with the splendour of millions of suns.17

প্রভাবে আকর্ষিল সব সন্ন্যাসীর মন ৷
উঠিলা সন্ন্যাসী সব ছাড়িয়া আসন ॥ ৬১ ॥

prabhāve ākarṣila saba sannyāsīra mana
by the splendour He attracted all of the sannyāsīs the minds
uṭhilā sannyāsī saba chāḍiyā āsana
rose the sannyāsīs all leaving their seats

61That splendour drew the minds of all the sannyāsīs, and they all rose from their seats.

প্রকাশানন্দ-নামে এক সন্ন্যাসী প্রধান ৷
প্রভুকে কহিল কিছু করিয়া সম্মান ॥ ৬২ ॥

prakāśānanda-nāme eka sannyāsī pradhāna
Prakāśānanda by name one sannyāsī chief
prabhuke kahila kichu kariyā sammāna
to the Lord spoke something showing respect

62The chief among the sannyāsīs, Prakāśānanda by name, addressed the Lord with respect:18

ইহাঁ আইস গোসাঞি, শুনহ শ্রীপাদ ৷
অপবিত্র স্থানে বৈস, কিবা অবসাদ ॥ ৬৩ ॥

ihām̐ āisa gosāñi, śunaha śrīpāda
here come Gosāñi listen Śrīpāda
apavitra sthāne vaisa, kibā avasāda
in an impure place You sit what dejection

63“Come here, Gosāñi; listen, Śrīpāda. You are sitting in an impure place — why are You so downcast?”

প্রভু কহে, — আমি হই হীন-সম্প্রদায় ৷
তোমা-সবার সম্প্রদায়ে বসিতে না যুয়ায় ॥ ৬৪ ॥

prabhu kahe, — āmi hai hīna-sampradāya
the Lord says I am of a lower sampradāya
tomā-sabāra sampradāye vasite nā yuyāya
of you all in the assembly to sit not befits

64The Lord replied, “I belong to a lower sampradāya; it is not fitting for Me to sit in your assembly.”19

আপনে প্রকাশানন্দ হাতেতে ধরিয়া ৷
বসাইল সভামধ্যে সম্মান করিয়া ॥ ৬৫ ॥

āpane prakāśānanda hātete dhariyā
himself Prakāśānanda by the hand taking
vasāila sabhā-madhye sammāna kariyā
seated in the midst of the assembly respect showing

65Then Prakāśānanda himself took Him by the hand and, with respect, seated Him in the midst of the assembly.

পুছিল, তোমার নাম ‘শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য’ ৷
কেশব-ভারতীর শিষ্য, তাতে তুমি ধন্য ॥ ৬৬ ॥

puchila, tomāra nāma ‘śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya’
he asked Your name ‘Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya’
keśava-bhāratīra śiṣya, tāte tumi dhanya
of Keśava Bhāratī the disciple therefore You are glorious

66He asked, “Your name is Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, is it not? You are a disciple of Keśava Bhāratī, and so You are worthy of glory.

সাম্প্রদায়িক সন্ন্যাসী তুমি, রহ এই গ্রামে ৷
কি কারণে আমা-সবার না কর দর্শনে ॥ ৬৭ ॥

sāmpradāyika sannyāsī tumi, raha ei grāme
of the sampradāya a sannyāsī You You live in this town
ki kāraṇe āmā-sabāra nā kara darśane
for what reason us all not You make seeing

67You are a sannyāsī of our own sampradāya and You live in this town; why then do You not come to see us?

সন্ন্যাসী হইয়া কর নর্ত্তন-গায়ন ৷
ভাবুক সব সঙ্গে লঞা করহ কীর্ত্তন ॥ ৬৮ ॥

sannyāsī haiyā kara nartana-gāyana
a sannyāsī being You do dancing and singing
bhāvuka saba saṅge lañā karaha kīrtana
sentimentalists all with taking You do kīrtana

68Though You are a sannyāsī, You dance and sing, and You take all these sentimentalists with You and perform kīrtana.

বেদান্ত-পঠন, ধ্যান, — সন্ন্যাসীর ধর্ম্ম ৷
তাহা ছাড়ি’ কর কেনে ভাবুকের কর্ম্ম ॥ ৬৯ ॥

vedānta-paṭhana, dhyāna, — sannyāsīra dharma
Vedānta-study meditation of a sannyāsī the dharma
tāhā chāḍi’ kara kene bhāvukera karma
that abandoning You do why of sentimentalists the work

69The study of Vedānta and meditation are the dharma of a sannyāsī; why do You abandon them and do the work of sentimentalists?

প্রভাবে দেখিয়ে তোমা সাক্ষাৎ নারায়ণ ৷
হীনাচার কর কেনে, ইথে কি কারণ ॥ ৭০ ॥

prabhāve dekhiye tomā sākṣāt nārāyaṇa
by Your splendour we see You directly Nārāyaṇa
hīnācāra kara kene, ithe ki kāraṇa
low conduct You do why in this what reason

70From Your splendour we see that You are Nārāyaṇa Himself; why then do You behave so lowly? What is the reason?”

প্রভু কহে, — শুন, শ্রীপাদ, ইহার কারণ ৷
গুরু মোরে মূর্খ দেখি’ করিল শাসন ॥ ৭১ ॥

prabhu kahe, — śuna, śrīpāda, ihāra kāraṇa
the Lord says listen Śrīpāda of this the reason
guru more mūrkha dekhi’ karila śāsana
the guru Me a fool seeing made chastisement

71The Lord said, “Listen, Śrīpāda, to the reason for this. My guru saw that I was a fool, and he chastised Me:20

মূর্খ তুমি, তোমার নাহি বেদান্তাধিকার ৷
‘কৃষ্ণমন্ত্র’ জপ’ সদা, — এই মন্ত্রসার ॥ ৭২ ॥

mūrkha tumi, tomāra nāhi vedāntādhikāra
a fool You are Your there is not qualification for Vedānta
‘kṛṣṇa-mantra’ japa’ sadā, — ei mantra-sāra
‘the Kṛṣṇa-mantra’ chant always this of mantras the essence

72‘You are a fool; You are not qualified for Vedānta. Always chant the Kṛṣṇa-mantra — it is the essence of all mantras.

কৃষ্ণমন্ত্র হৈতে হবে সংসার-মোচন ৷
কৃষ্ণনাম হৈতে পাবে কৃষ্ণের চরণ ॥ ৭৩ ॥

kṛṣṇa-mantra haite habe saṁsāra-mocana
the Kṛṣṇa-mantra from will be from saṁsāra release
kṛṣṇa-nāma haite pābe kṛṣṇera caraṇa
Kṛṣṇa’s name from You will attain Kṛṣṇa’s feet

73From the Kṛṣṇa-mantra will come release from saṁsāra, and by Kṛṣṇa’s name You will attain Kṛṣṇa’s feet.21

নাম বিনা কলিকালে নাহি আর ধর্ম্ম ৷
সর্ব্বমন্ত্রসার নাম, — এই শাস্ত্রমর্ম্ম ॥ ৭৪ ॥

nāma vinā kali-kāle nāhi āra dharma
the name without in the age of Kali there is not other dharma
sarva-mantra-sāra nāma, — ei śāstra-marma
of all mantras the essence the name this of scripture the heart

74In the age of Kali there is no dharma other than the name; the name is the essence of all mantras — this is the heart of the scriptures.’

এত বলি’ এক শ্লোক শিখাইল মোরে ৷
কণ্ঠে করি’ এই শ্লোক করিহ বিচারে ॥ ৭৫ ॥

eta bali’ eka śloka śikhāila more
thus saying one verse he taught Me
kaṇṭhe kari’ ei śloka kariha vicāre
in the throat keeping this verse make reflection

75Saying this, he taught Me a verse: ‘Keep this verse on Your lips and reflect on it.’

হরের্নাম হরের্নাম হরের্নামৈব কেবলম্ ৷
কলৌ নাস্ত্যেব নাস্ত্যেব নাস্ত্যেব গতিরন্যথা ॥ ৭৬ ॥

harer nāma harer nāma
of Hari the name of Hari the name
harer nāmaiva kevalam
of Hari the name indeed only
kalau nāsty eva nāsty eva
in Kali there is not indeed there is not indeed
nāsty eva gatir anyathā
there is not indeed way other

76“The name of Hari, the name of Hari, the name of Hari alone! In the age of Kali there is no other way, there is no other way, there is no other way.” (Bṛhan-nāradīya Purāṇa, 38.126)22

এই আজ্ঞা পাঞা নাম লই অনুক্ষণ ৷
নাম লৈতে লৈতে মোর ভ্রান্ত হৈল মন ॥ ৭৭ ॥

ei ājñā pāñā nāma lai anukṣaṇa
this order receiving the name I take constantly
nāma laite laite mora bhrānta haila mana
the name taking taking My bewildered became mind

77Receiving this order, I took the name constantly, and as I chanted on and on, My mind grew bewildered.

ধৈর্য্য ধরিতে নারি, হৈলাম উন্মত্ত ৷
হাসি, কান্দি, নাচি, গাই, যৈছে মদমত্ত ॥ ৭৮ ॥

dhairya dharite nāri, hailāma unmatta
composure to hold I cannot I became mad
hāsi, kāndi, nāci, gāi, yaiche madamatta
I laugh I weep I dance I sing like one intoxicated

78I could no longer keep My composure; I became mad. I laughed and wept, I danced and sang like one intoxicated.

তবে ধৈর্য্য ধরি’ মনে করিলাম বিচার ৷
কৃষ্ণনামে জ্ঞানাচ্ছন্ন হইল আমার ॥ ৭৯ ॥

tabe dhairya dhari’ mane karilāma vicāra
then composure holding in the mind I made consideration
kṛṣṇa-nāme jñānācchanna haila āmāra
by Kṛṣṇa’s name knowledge-covered became My

79Then, gathering My composure, I reflected: ‘Kṛṣṇa’s name has covered all My knowledge.

পাগল হইলাঙ আমি, ধৈর্য্য নাহি মনে ৷
এত চিন্তি’ নিবেদিলাম গুরুর চরণে ॥ ৮০ ॥

pāgala hailāṅa āmi, dhairya nāhi mane
mad have become I composure there is not in the mind
eta cinti’ nivedilāma gurura caraṇe
thus thinking I submitted at the guru’s feet

80I have gone mad; there is no composure left in My mind.’ Thinking this, I came to the feet of My guru and said:

কিবা মন্ত্র দিলা, গোসাঞি, কিবা তার বল ৷
জপিতে জপিতে মন্ত্র করিল পাগল ॥ ৮১ ॥

kibā mantra dilā, gosāñi, kibā tāra bala
what mantra you gave Gosāñi what its power
japite japite mantra karila pāgala
chanting chanting the mantra made mad

81‘What mantra have you given Me, Gosāñi? What power it has! Chanting it again and again, I have gone mad.

হাসায়, নাচায়, মোরে করায় ক্রন্দন ৷
এত শুনি’ গুরু মোরে বলিলা বচন ॥ ৮২ ॥

hāsāya, nācāya, more karāya krandana
it makes laugh makes dance Me makes weep
eta śuni’ guru more balilā vacana
this hearing the guru to Me spoke words

82It makes Me laugh, it makes Me dance, it makes Me weep.’ Hearing this, My guru spoke these words to Me:

কৃষ্ণনাম-মহামন্ত্রের এই ত’ স্বভাব ৷
যেই জপে, তার কৃষ্ণে উপজয়ে ভাব ॥ ৮৩ ॥

kṛṣṇa-nāma-mahā-mantrera ei ta’ svabhāva
of the great mantra of Kṛṣṇa’s name this indeed the nature
yei jape, tāra kṛṣṇe upajaye bhāva
whoever chants his for Kṛṣṇa arises bhāva

83‘Such is the nature of the great mantra, Kṛṣṇa’s name: it awakens bhāva for Kṛṣṇa in whoever chants it.23

কৃষ্ণবিষয়ক প্রেমা — পরম পুরুষার্থ ৷
যার আগে তৃণতুল্য চারি পুরুষার্থ ॥ ৮৪ ॥

kṛṣṇa-viṣayaka premā — parama puruṣārtha
for Kṛṣṇa prema the supreme goal of life
yāra āge tṛṇa-tulya cāri puruṣārtha
before which like straw the four goals of life

84Prema for Kṛṣṇa is the supreme aim of human life; before it the four other goals are like straw.

পঞ্চম পুরুষার্থ — প্রেমানন্দামৃতসিন্ধু ৷
ব্রহ্মাদি আনন্দ যার নহে এক বিন্দু ॥ ৮৫ ॥

pañcama puruṣārtha — premānandāmṛta-sindhu
the fifth goal of life an ocean of the nectar of the bliss of prema
brahmādi ānanda yāra nahe eka bindu
of Brahman and the rest the bliss of which is not one drop

85The fifth goal of life is prema, a boundless ocean of nectarean bliss; the bliss of Brahman and all the rest is not equal to a single drop of it.24

কৃষ্ণনামের ফল — ‘প্রেমা’, সর্ব্বশাস্ত্রে কয় ৷
ভাগ্যে সেই প্রেমা তোমায় করিল উদয় ॥ ৮৬ ॥

kṛṣṇa-nāmera phala — ‘premā’, sarva-śāstre kaya
of Kṛṣṇa’s name the fruit ‘prema’ in all scriptures it is said
bhāgye sei premā tomāya karila udaya
by good fortune that prema in You has made dawning

86All the scriptures say that the fruit of Kṛṣṇa’s name is prema, and by good fortune that prema has dawned in You.

প্রেমার স্বভাবে করে চিত্ত-তনু ক্ষোভ ৷
কৃষ্ণের চরণ-প্রাপ্ত্যে উপজায় লোভ ॥ ৮৭ ॥

premāra svabhāve kare citta-tanu kṣobha
by prema’s nature it makes of mind and body agitation
kṛṣṇera caraṇa-prāptye upajāya lobha
of Kṛṣṇa’s feet for the attainment arises greed

87It is the nature of prema to stir both mind and body and to awaken a burning longing to attain Kṛṣṇa’s feet.

প্রেমার স্বভাবে ভক্ত হাসে, কান্দে, গায় ৷
উন্মত্ত হইয়া নাচে, ইতি-উতি ধায় ॥ ৮৮ ॥

premāra svabhāve bhakta hāse, kānde, gāya
by prema’s nature the devotee laughs weeps sings
unmatta haiyā nāce, iti-uti dhāya
mad becoming dances here and there runs

88Moved by prema, the devotee laughs, weeps and sings; as if mad, he dances and runs here and there.25

স্বেদ, কম্প, রোমাঞ্চাশ্রু, গদ্গদ, বৈবর্ণ্য ৷
উন্মাদ, বিষাদ, ধৈর্য্য, গর্ব্ব, হর্ষ, দৈন্য ॥ ৮৯ ॥

এত ভাবে প্রেমা ভক্তগণেরে নাচায় ৷
কৃষ্ণের আনন্দামৃতসাগরে ভাসায় ॥ ৯০ ॥

sveda, kampa, romāñcāśru, gadgada, vaivarṇya
perspiration trembling hair standing on end and tears faltering voice pallor
unmāda, viṣāda, dhairya, garva, harṣa, dainya
madness despondency steadiness pride joy humility
eta bhāve premā bhakta-gaṇere nācāya
with so many feelings prema the devotees makes dance
kṛṣṇera ānandāmṛta-sāgare bhāsāya
in Kṛṣṇa’s ocean of the nectar of bliss makes float

89–90Perspiration, trembling, hair standing on end, tears, a faltering voice and change of colour; madness, despondency, steadiness, pride, joy and humility — with all these feelings prema makes the devotees dance and sets them afloat on the ocean of the nectar of Kṛṣṇa’s bliss.

ভাল হৈল, পাইলে তুমি পরমপুরুষার্থ ৷
তোমার প্রেমেতে আমি হৈলাঙ কৃতার্থ ॥ ৯১ ॥

bhāla haila, pāile tumi parama-puruṣārtha
good it is You have attained You the supreme goal of life
tomāra premete āmi hailāṅa kṛtārtha
by Your prema I have become fulfilled

91It is good that You have attained the supreme goal of life; by Your prema my own life has been fulfilled.

নাচ, গাও, ভক্তসঙ্গে কর সংকীর্ত্তন ৷
কৃষ্ণনাম উপদেশি’ তার’ সর্ব্বজন ॥ ৯২ ॥

nāca, gāo, bhakta-saṅge kara saṅkīrtana
dance sing with the devotees perform saṅkīrtana
kṛṣṇa-nāma upadeśi’ tāra’ sarva-jana
Kṛṣṇa’s name teaching deliver all people

92Dance, sing and perform saṅkīrtana with the devotees; teach Kṛṣṇa’s name and deliver all people.’26

এত বলি’ এক শ্লোক শিখাইল মোরে ৷
ভাগবতের সার এই বলে বারে বারে ॥ ৯৩ ॥

eta bali’ eka śloka śikhāila more
thus saying one verse he taught Me
bhāgavatera sāra ei bale vāre vāre
of the Bhāgavata the essence this he says again again

93Saying this, he taught Me a verse and told Me again and again: ‘This is the essence of the Bhāgavata.’

এবংব্রতঃ স্বপ্রিয়নামকীর্ত্ত্যা-
জাতানুরাগো দ্রুতচিত্ত উচ্চৈঃ ৷
হসত্যথো রোদিতি রৌতি গায়-
ত্যুন্মাদবন্নৃত্যতি লোকবাহ্যঃ ॥ ৯৪ ॥

evaṁ-vrataḥ sva-priya-nāma-kīrtyā
one with such a vow by the chanting of the names of his beloved
jātānurāgo druta-citta uccaiḥ
in whom love has arisen with melted heart loudly
hasaty atho roditi rauti gāyaty
laughs then weeps cries out sings
unmāda-van nṛtyati loka-bāhyaḥ
like a madman dances beyond the world

94“One who has taken this vow, chanting the names of his beloved Lord, finds love awakening within him; his heart melts, and, heedless of the world, he laughs aloud, weeps, cries out, sings and dances like a madman.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 11.2.40)27

এই তাঁর বাক্যে আমি দৃঢ় বিশ্বাস ধরি’ ৷
নিরন্তর কৃষ্ণনাম সংকীর্ত্তন করি ॥ ৯৫ ॥

ei tām̐ra vākye āmi dṛḍha viśvāsa dhari’
this his in the words I firm faith holding
nirantara kṛṣṇa-nāma saṅkīrtana kari
constantly Kṛṣṇa’s name saṅkīrtana I do

95With firm faith in these words of his, I constantly perform the saṅkīrtana of Kṛṣṇa’s name.

সেই কৃষ্ণনাম কভু গাওয়ায়, নাচায় ৷
গাহি, নাচি নাহি আমি আপন-ইচ্ছায় ॥ ৯৬ ॥

sei kṛṣṇa-nāma kabhu gāoyāya, nācāya
that Kṛṣṇa’s name at times makes sing makes dance
gāhi, nāci nāhi āmi āpana-icchāya
I sing I dance not I by My own will

96That name of Kṛṣṇa sometimes makes Me sing and dance; I do not sing and dance of My own will.28

কৃষ্ণনামে যে আনন্দসিন্ধু-আস্বাদন ৷
ব্রহ্মানন্দ তার আগে খাতোদক-সম ॥ ৯৭ ॥

kṛṣṇa-nāme ye ānanda-sindhu-āsvādana
in Kṛṣṇa’s name which of the ocean of bliss the tasting
brahmānanda tāra āge khātodaka-sama
the bliss of Brahman of that before like water in a ditch

97Before the ocean of bliss tasted in Kṛṣṇa’s name, the bliss of Brahman is like water in a ditch.

ত্বৎসাক্ষাৎকরণাহ্লাদ-বিশুদ্ধাব্ধিস্থিতস্য মে ৷
সুখানি গোষ্পদায়ন্তে ব্রাহ্মাণ্যপি জগদ্গুরো ॥ ৯৮ ॥

tvat-sākṣāt-karaṇāhlāda-
from seeing You face to face the joy
viśuddhābdhi-sthitasya me
in the pure ocean situated for me
sukhāni goṣ-padāyante
joys become like a calf’s hoofprint
brāhmāṇy api jagad-guro
of Brahman even O Guru of the world

98“O Guru of the world, now that I am immersed in the pure ocean of joy that comes from seeing You face to face, all other joys — even the bliss of Brahman — seem to me like the water in a calf’s hoofprint.” (Hari-bhakti-sudhodaya, 14.36)

প্রভুর মিষ্টবাক্য শুনি’ সন্ন্যাসীর গণ ৷
চিত্ত ফিরি’ গেল, কহে মধুর বচন ॥ ৯৯ ॥

prabhura miṣṭa-vākya śuni’ sannyāsīra gaṇa
the Lord’s sweet words hearing of the sannyāsīs the company
citta phiri’ gela, kahe madhura vacana
their hearts turning went they speak sweet words

99Hearing the Lord’s sweet words, the sannyāsīs had a change of heart, and they answered Him with gentle words:

যে কিছু কহিলে তুমি, সর্ব্ব সত্য হয় ৷
কৃষ্ণপ্রেমা সেই পায়, যার ভাগ্যোদয় ॥ ১০০ ॥

ye kichu kahile tumi, sarva satya haya
whatever You have said You all true is
kṛṣṇa-premā sei pāya, yāra bhāgyodaya
love for Kṛṣṇa he attains whose fortune has dawned

100“All that You have said is true: love for Kṛṣṇa is attained only by one whose good fortune has dawned.

কৃষ্ণে ভক্তি কর — ইহায় সবার সন্তোষ ৷
বেদান্ত না শুন কেনে, তার কিবা দোষ ॥ ১০১ ॥

kṛṣṇe bhakti kara — ihāya sabāra santoṣa
to Kṛṣṇa devotion You practise in this of all the satisfaction
vedānta nā śuna kene, tāra kibā doṣa
Vedānta not You hear why its what fault

101You have devotion for Kṛṣṇa, and we are all pleased with that. But why do You not hear Vedānta? What fault is there in it?”29

এত শুনি’ হাসি’ প্রভু বলিলা বচন ৷
দুঃখ না মানিহ যদি, করি নিবেদন ॥ ১০২ ॥

eta śuni’ hāsi’ prabhu balilā vacana
this hearing smiling the Lord spoke words
duḥkha nā māniha yadi, kari nivedana
offence not you take if I make submission

102Hearing this, the Lord smiled and said, “If you will not take offence, I shall explain.”

ইহা শুনি’ বলে সর্ব্ব সন্ন্যাসীর গণ ৷
তোমাকে দেখিয়ে যৈছে সাক্ষাৎ নারায়ণ ॥ ১০৩ ॥

ihā śuni’ bale sarva sannyāsīra gaṇa
this hearing say all of the sannyāsīs the company
tomāke dekhiye yaiche sākṣāt nārāyaṇa
You we see as directly Nārāyaṇa

103At this all the sannyāsīs said, “We see You as Nārāyaṇa Himself.

তোমার বচন শুনি’ জুড়ায় শ্রবণ ৷
তোমার মাধুরী দেখি’ জুড়ায় নয়ন ॥ ১০৪ ॥

tomāra vacana śuni’ juḍāya śravaṇa
Your words hearing are soothed the ears
tomāra mādhurī dekhi’ juḍāya nayana
Your sweetness seeing are soothed the eyes

104Your words soothe our ears, and the sight of Your sweetness soothes our eyes.

তোমার প্রভাবে সবার আনন্দিত মন ৷
কভু অসঙ্গত নহে তোমার বচন ॥ ১০৫ ॥

tomāra prabhāve sabāra ānandita mana
by Your influence of all joyful the minds
kabhu asaṅgata nahe tomāra vacana
ever unfitting not are Your words

105Your presence has filled all our hearts with joy, and Your words are never unfitting.”

প্রভু কহে, বেদান্ত-সূত্র — ঈশ্বর-বচন ৷
ব্যাসরূপে কৈল তাহা শ্রীনারায়ণ ॥ ১০৬ ॥

prabhu kahe, vedānta-sūtra — īśvara-vacana
the Lord says the Vedānta-sūtra of Īśvara the words
vyāsa-rūpe kaila tāhā śrī-nārāyaṇa
in the form of Vyāsa composed it Śrī Nārāyaṇa

106The Lord said, “The Vedānta-sūtra is the word of the Lord: Śrī Nārāyaṇa Himself composed it in the form of Vyāsa.30

ভ্রম, প্রমাদ, বিপ্রলিপ্সা, করণাপাটব ৷
ঈশ্বরের বাক্যে নাহি দোষ এই সব ॥ ১০৭ ॥

bhrama, pramāda, vipralipsā, karaṇāpāṭava
error inattention the wish to deceive imperfection of the senses
īśvarera vākye nāhi doṣa ei saba
of Īśvara in the words there are not faults these all

107Error, inattention, the wish to deceive and the imperfection of the senses — none of these faults is found in the words of the Lord.

উপনিষৎ-সহিত সূত্র কহে যেই তত্ত্ব ৷
মুখ্যবৃত্ত্যে সেই অর্থ পরম মহত্ত্ব ॥ ১০৮ ॥

upaniṣat-sahita sūtra kahe yei tattva
the Upaniṣads together with the sūtras speak which truth
mukhya-vṛttye sei artha parama mahattva
by the primary sense that meaning of supreme greatness

108The truth that the sūtras declare together with the Upaniṣads is of supreme greatness when taken in its primary sense.31

গৌণ-বৃত্ত্যে যেবা ভাষ্য করিল আচার্য্য ৷
তাহার শ্রবণে নাশ যায় সর্ব্ব কার্য্য ॥ ১০৯ ॥

gauṇa-vṛttye yebā bhāṣya karila ācārya
by the secondary sense the commentary made the Ācārya
tāhāra śravaṇe nāśa yāya sarva kārya
its by hearing ruin goes all work

109But to hear the commentary that the Ācārya wrote in the secondary sense is to lose every spiritual gain.

তাঁহার নাহিক দোষ, ঈশ্বর-আজ্ঞা পাঞা ৷
গৌণার্থ করিল মুখ্য অর্থ আচ্ছাদিয়া ॥ ১১০ ॥

tām̐hāra nāhika doṣa, īśvara-ājñā pāñā
his there is not fault of Īśvara the order receiving
gauṇārtha karila mukhya artha ācchādiyā
the secondary meaning he made the primary meaning covering

110The fault is not his: he received the Lord’s order and so gave the secondary meaning, covering the primary.32

‘ব্রহ্ম’-শব্দে মুখ্য অর্থে কহে — ‘ভগবান্’ ৷
চিদৈশ্বর্য্য-পরিপূর্ণ, অনূর্দ্ধ-সমান ॥ ১১১ ॥

‘brahma’-śabde mukhya arthe kahe — ‘bhagavān’
‘Brahman’-in the word in the primary sense says ‘Bhagavān’
cid-aiśvarya-paripūrṇa, anūrdhva-samāna
with spiritual majesty full having none above or equal

111In its primary sense the word “Brahman” means Bhagavān, full of spiritual majesty, with none above Him or equal to Him.

তাঁহার বিভূতি, দেহ, — সব চিদাকার ৷
চিদ্বিভূতি আচ্ছাদিয়া কহে ‘নিরাকার’ ॥ ১১২ ॥

tām̐hāra vibhūti, deha, — saba cid-ākāra
His opulence body all of spiritual form
cid-vibhūti ācchādiyā kahe ‘nirākāra’
the spiritual opulence covering he calls ‘formless’

112His opulence and His body are all spiritual in form; but, covering His spiritual opulence, the Ācārya calls Him “formless”.

চিদানন্দ — দেহ, তাঁর স্থান, পরিবার ৷
তাঁরে কহে — প্রাকৃত-সত্ত্বের বিকার ॥ ১১৩ ॥

cid-ānanda — deha, tām̐ra sthāna, parivāra
spiritual bliss His body His abode retinue
tām̐re kahe — prākṛta-sattvera vikāra
Him they call of material sattva a transformation

113His body, His abode and His retinue are spiritual bliss, yet they say that He is a transformation of material sattva.

তাঁর দোষ নাহি, তেঁহো আজ্ঞাকারী দাস ৷
আর যেই শুনে, তার হয় সর্ব্বনাশ ॥ ১১৪ ॥

tām̐ra doṣa nāhi, tem̐ho ājñā-kārī dāsa
his fault there is not he order-carrying servant
āra yei śune, tāra haya sarva-nāśa
but whoever hears his is utter ruin

114The fault is not his, for he is a servant who carries out orders; but whoever listens to him meets with utter ruin.

প্রাকৃত করিয়া মানে বিষ্ণু-কলেবর ৷
বিষ্ণুনিন্দা আর নাহি ইহার উপর ॥ ১১৫ ॥

prākṛta kariyā māne viṣṇu-kalevara
material taking he regards Viṣṇu’s body
viṣṇu-nindā āra nāhi ihāra upara
Viṣṇu-blasphemy other there is not this above

115One who regards the body of Viṣṇu as material commits the gravest blasphemy against Viṣṇu; there is none greater than this.

ঈশ্বরের তত্ত্ব — যেন জ্বলিত জ্বলন ৷
জীবের স্বরূপ যৈছে স্ফুলিঙ্গের কণ ॥ ১১৬ ॥

īśvarera tattva — yena jvalita jvalana
of Īśvara the truth like blazing fire
jīvera svarūpa yaiche sphuliṅgera kaṇa
of the jīva the nature like of a spark a particle

116The truth of the Lord is like a blazing fire, and the jīva in its true nature is like a particle of a spark.

জীবতত্ত্ব — শক্তি, কৃষ্ণতত্ত্ব — শক্তিমান্ ৷
গীতা-বিষ্ণুপুরাণাদি তাহাতে প্রমাণ ॥ ১১৭ ॥

jīva-tattva — śakti, kṛṣṇa-tattva — śaktimān
the jīva-truth potency the Kṛṣṇa-truth the possessor of potency
gītā-viṣṇupurāṇādi tāhāte pramāṇa
Gītā Viṣṇu Purāṇa and others in that the evidence

117The jīva is a potency (śakti); Kṛṣṇa is the possessor of all potency (śaktimān). The Gītā, the Viṣṇu Purāṇa and other scriptures bear witness to this.

অপরেয়মিতস্ত্বন্যাং প্রকৃতিং বিদ্ধি মে পরাম্ ৷
জীবভূতাং মহাবাহো যয়েদং ধার্য্যতে জগৎ ॥ ১১৮ ॥

apareyam itas tv anyāṁ
inferior this beyond this but another
prakṛtiṁ viddhi me parām
nature know My superior
jīva-bhūtāṁ mahā-bāho
consisting of jīvas O mighty-armed
yayedaṁ dhāryate jagat
by which this is taken up the world

118“This nature is inferior. But know, O mighty-armed, that I have another, superior nature, consisting of the jīvas, who take up this world for their own enjoyment.” (Bhagavad-gītā, 7.5)33

বিষ্ণুশক্তিঃ পরা প্রোক্তা ক্ষেত্রজ্ঞাখ্যা তথাপরা ৷
অবিদ্যা-কর্ম্মসংজ্ঞান্যা তৃতীয়া শক্তিরিষ্যতে ॥ ১১৯ ॥

viṣṇu-śaktiḥ parā proktā
Viṣṇu’s potency superior is declared
kṣetrajñākhyā tathā parā
called the knower of the field likewise superior
avidyā-karma-saṁjñānyā
called ignorance and karma another
tṛtīyā śaktir iṣyate
a third potency is held to be

119“The potency of Viṣṇu is declared to be superior; the potency called the knower of the field (kṣetrajña) is likewise superior; and the other, called ignorance and karma, is held to be a third potency.” (Viṣṇu Purāṇa, 6.7.61)34

হেন জীবতত্ত্ব লঞা লিখি’ পরতত্ত্ব ৷
আচ্ছন্ন করিল শ্রেষ্ঠ ঈশ্বর-মহত্ত্ব ॥ ১২০ ॥

hena jīva-tattva lañā likhi’ para-tattva
such the jīva-truth taking writing the supreme truth
ācchanna karila śreṣṭha īśvara-mahattva
covering he made the highest of Īśvara greatness

120Yet the Ācārya took such a jīva and declared it to be the Supreme Truth, and so he hid the supreme greatness of the Lord.35

ব্যাসের সূত্রেতে কহে ‘পরিণাম’-বাদ ৷
ব্যাস ভ্রান্ত — বলি’ তার উঠাইল বিবাদ ॥ ১২১ ॥

vyāsera sūtrete kahe ‘pariṇāma’-vāda
of Vyāsa in the sūtras is told ‘transformation’-doctrine
vyāsa bhrānta — bali’ tāra uṭhāila vivāda
Vyāsa mistaken saying his raised dispute

121In Vyāsa’s sūtras the doctrine of transformation (pariṇāma-vāda) is taught; but Śaṅkara said that Vyāsa was mistaken and raised a dispute.36

পরিণাম-বাদে ঈশ্বর হয়েন বিকারী ৷
এত কহি’ ‘বিবর্ত্ত’-বাদ স্থাপনা যে করি ॥ ১২২ ॥

pariṇāma-vāde īśvara hayena vikārī
in the transformation-doctrine Īśvara becomes changeable
eta kahi’ ‘vivarta’-vāda sthāpanā ye kari
thus saying ‘appearance’-doctrine establishment which he made

122He argued that under the doctrine of transformation the Lord would be subject to change, and on that ground he established vivarta-vāda, the doctrine of illusion.37

বস্তুতঃ পরিণাম-বাদ — সেই সে প্রমাণ ৷
দেহে আত্মবুদ্ধি — হয় বিবর্ত্তের স্থান ॥ ১২৩ ॥

vastutaḥ pariṇāma-vāda — sei se pramāṇa
in reality the transformation-doctrine that alone the authority
dehe ātma-buddhi — haya vivartera sthāna
in the body the sense of self is of vivarta the place

123In truth the doctrine of transformation alone is authoritative; illusion lies in taking the body for the self.38

অবিচিন্ত্য-শক্তিযুক্ত শ্রীভগবান্ ৷
ইচ্ছায় জগৎরূপে পায় পরিণাম ॥ ১২৪ ॥

avicintya-śakti-yukta śrī-bhagavān
with inconceivable potency endowed Śrī Bhagavān
icchāya jagat-rūpe pāya pariṇāma
by His will in the form of the world undergoes transformation

124Śrī Bhagavān possesses inconceivable potency, and by His own will He is transformed into the world.39

তথাপি অচিন্ত্যশক্ত্যে হয় অবিকারী ৷
প্রাকৃত চিন্তামণি তাহে দৃষ্টান্ত ধরি ॥ ১২৫ ॥

tathāpi acintya-śaktye haya avikārī
still by inconceivable potency He is unchanged
prākṛta cintāmaṇi tāhe dṛṣṭānta dhari
the material cintāmaṇi in this as an example we hold

125Yet by that same inconceivable potency He remains unchanged. We find an example of this even in this world — the cintāmaṇi stone.

নানা রত্ন-রাশি হয় চিন্তামণি হৈতে ৷
তথাপিহ মণি রহে স্বরূপে অবিকৃতে ॥ ১২৬ ॥

nānā ratna-rāśi haya cintāmaṇi haite
various heaps of jewels come from the cintāmaṇi
tathāpiha maṇi rahe svarūpe avikṛte
yet the gem remains in its own nature unchanged

126Heaps of various jewels come from the cintāmaṇi, yet the gem itself remains unchanged in its nature.

প্রাকৃত-বস্তুতে যদি অচিন্ত্যশক্তি হয় ৷
ঈশ্বরের অচিন্ত্যশক্তি, — ইথে কি বিস্ময় ॥ ১২৭ ॥

prākṛta-vastute yadi acintya-śakti haya
in a material thing if inconceivable potency is
īśvarera acintya-śakti, — ithe ki vismaya
of Īśvara inconceivable potency in this what wonder

127If even a material thing possesses inconceivable power, what wonder is there in the inconceivable potency of the Lord?

‘প্রণব’ সে মহাবাক্য বেদের নিদান ৷
ঈশ্বরস্বরূপ প্রণব — সর্ব্ববিশ্ব-ধাম ॥ ১২৮ ॥

‘praṇava’ se mahāvākya vedera nidāna
‘praṇava’ that great utterance of the Vedas the source
īśvara-svarūpa praṇava — sarva-viśva-dhāma
the Lord’s own form praṇava of all universes the abode

128The praṇava (oṁ) is the great utterance, the source of the Vedas; the praṇava is the Lord Himself in sound, the abode of all the universes.40

সর্ব্বাশ্রয় ঈশ্বরের করি প্রণব উদ্দেশ ৷
‘তত্ত্বমসি’ বাক্য হয় বেদের এক দেশ ॥ ১২৯ ॥

sarvāśraya īśvarera kari praṇava uddeśa
the shelter of all of Īśvara makes praṇava indication
‘tat tvam asi’ vākya haya vedera eka deśa
‘tat tvam asi’ the utterance is of the Veda one part

129The praṇava points to the Lord, the shelter of all, whereas the utterance tat tvam asi is one particular statement of the Veda.41

‘প্রণব’ মহাবাক্য — তাহা করি’ আচ্ছাদন ৷
মহাবাক্যে করি’ ‘তত্ত্বমসি’র স্থাপন ॥ ১৩০ ॥

‘praṇava’ mahā-vākya — tāhā kari’ ācchādana
‘praṇava’ the great utterance that making covering
mahāvākye kari’ ‘tat tvam asi’ra sthāpana
as the great utterance making of ‘tat tvam asi’ establishment

130The praṇava is the great utterance; but he covered this and set up tat tvam asi as the great utterance instead.

সর্ব্ববেদসূত্রে করে কৃষ্ণের অভিধান ৷
মুখ্যবৃত্তি ছাড়ি’ কৈল লক্ষণা-ব্যাখ্যান ॥ ১৩১ ॥

sarva-veda-sūtre kare kṛṣṇera abhidhāna
in all the Vedas and sūtras is made of Kṛṣṇa the naming
mukhya-vṛtti chāḍi’ kaila lakṣaṇā-vyākhyāna
the primary sense abandoning he made secondary explanation

131All the Vedas and sūtras name Kṛṣṇa in their primary sense; but he abandoned the primary sense and explained them by the secondary one (lakṣaṇā).42

স্বতঃপ্রমাণ বেদ — প্রমাণ-শিরোমণি ৷
লক্ষণা করিলে স্বতঃপ্রমাণতা-হানি ॥ ১৩২ ॥

svataḥ-pramāṇa veda — pramāṇa-śiromaṇi
self-evident the Veda of proofs the crest-jewel
lakṣaṇā karile svataḥ-pramāṇatā-hāni
by lakṣaṇā if one makes of self-evidence the loss

132The Veda is self-evident, the crest-jewel of all proofs; interpreted by the secondary sense, it loses that self-evidence.

এইমত প্রতিসূত্রে সহজার্থ ছাড়িয়া ৷
গৌণার্থ ব্যাখ্যা করে সব কল্পনা করিয়া ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

ei mata pratisūtre sahajārtha chāḍiyā
in this way in every sūtra the natural meaning abandoning
gauṇārtha vyākhyā kare saba kalpanā kariyā
the secondary meaning explanation he makes all imagining

133So in every sūtra he abandoned the natural meaning and explained it by a secondary one, inventing it all himself.”

এইমতে প্রতিসূত্রে করেন দূষণ ৷
শুনি’ চমৎকার হৈল সন্ন্যাসীর গণ ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

ei mate pratisūtre karena dūṣaṇa
in this way in every sūtra He makes fault-finding
śuni’ camatkāra haila sannyāsīra gaṇa
hearing astonished became of the sannyāsīs the company

134In this way He showed the faults in the commentary on every sūtra, and the sannyāsīs were astonished to hear it.

সকল সন্ন্যাসী কহে, — ‘শুনহ শ্রীপাদ ৷
তুমি যে খণ্ডিলে অর্থ, এ নহে বিবাদ ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

sakala sannyāsī kahe, — ‘śunaha śrīpāda
all the sannyāsīs say listen Śrīpāda
tumi ye khaṇḍile artha, e nahe vivāda
You which have refuted the meaning this is not a matter of dispute

135All the sannyāsīs said, “Listen, Śrīpāda: the meaning You have refuted is beyond dispute.43

আচার্য্য-কল্পিত অর্থ, — ইহা সবে জানি ৷
সম্প্রদায়-অনুরোধে তত্ত্ব ইহা মানি ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

ācārya-kalpita artha, — ihā sabe jāni
by the Ācārya imagined the meaning this all we know
sampradāya-anurodhe tattva ihā māni
of the sampradāya out of deference the truth this we accept

136We all know that the meaning is the Ācārya’s own invention; yet out of deference to our sampradāya we accept it as the truth.

মুখ্যার্থ ব্যাখ্যা কর, দেখি তোমার বল ৷’
মুখ্যার্থে লাগা’ল প্রভু সূত্রসকল ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

mukhyārtha vyākhyā kara, dekhi tomāra bala’
the primary meaning explanation make let us see Your power
mukhyārthe lāgā’la prabhu sūtra-sakala
in the primary meaning set the Lord the sūtras all

137Explain the primary meaning; let us see Your power.” And the Lord set about explaining all the sūtras in their primary meaning:

বৃহদ্বস্তু ‘ব্রহ্ম’ কহি — ‘শ্রীভগবান্’ ৷
ষড়্বিধৈশ্বর্য্যপূর্ণ, পরতত্ত্বধাম ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

bṛhad-vastu ‘brahma’ kahi — ‘śrī-bhagavān’
the great reality ‘Brahman’ we call ‘Śrī Bhagavān’
ṣaḍ-vidhaiśvarya-pūrṇa, para-tattva-dhāma
with six kinds of majesty full of the Supreme Truth the abode

138“The great reality called Brahman is Śrī Bhagavān, full of the six kinds of majesty, the abode of the Supreme Truth.44

স্বরূপ-ঐশ্বর্য্যে তাঁর নাহি মায়াগন্ধ ৷
সকল বেদের হয় ভগবান্ সে ‘সম্বন্ধ’ ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

svarūpa-aiśvarye tām̐ra nāhi māyā-gandha
in His own form and majesty His there is not of māyā a trace
sakala vedera haya bhagavān se ‘sambandha’
of all the Vedas is Bhagavān that ‘sambandha’

139In His own form and majesty there is not a trace of māyā; in all the Vedas Bhagavān is the sambandha — the One to whom everything is related.

তাঁরে ‘নির্ব্বিশেষ’ কহি, চিচ্ছক্তি না মানি’ ৷
অর্দ্ধ স্বরূপ না মানিলে পূর্ণতা হয় হানি ॥ ১৪০ ॥

tām̐re ‘nirviśeṣa’ kahi, cic-chakti nā māni’
Him ‘featureless’ we call the spiritual potency not accepting
ardha svarūpa nā mānile pūrṇatā haya hāni
half of His being not if one accepts fullness is harmed

140To call Him featureless (nirviśeṣa) is to deny His spiritual potency; and one who does not accept half of His being diminishes His fullness.45

ভগবান্-প্রাপ্তিহেতু যে করি উপায় ৷
শ্রবণাদি ভক্তি — কৃষ্ণপ্রাপ্ত্যের সহায় ॥ ১৪১ ॥

bhagavān-prāpti-hetu ye kari upāya
Bhagavān-attainment for which I make means
śravaṇādi bhakti — kṛṣṇa-prāptyera sahāya
hearing and the rest devotion of Kṛṣṇa’s attainment the help

141The means by which one attains Bhagavān is devotion beginning with hearing; it is what brings one to Kṛṣṇa.

সেই সর্ব্ববেদের ‘অভিধেয়’ নাম ৷
সাধনভক্তি হৈতে হয় প্রেমের উদ্গম ॥ ১৪২ ॥

sei sarva-vedera ‘abhidheya’ nāma
that of all the Vedas ‘abhidheya’ the name
sādhana-bhakti haite haya premera udgama
from sādhana-bhakti is of prema the sprouting

142All the Vedas call this the abhidheya, the means to be practised; from devotion in practice (sādhana-bhakti) prema springs up.46

কৃষ্ণের চরণে হয় যদি অনুরাগ ৷
কৃষ্ণ বিনু অন্যত্র তার নাহি রহে রাগ ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

kṛṣṇera caraṇe haya yadi anurāga
Kṛṣṇa’s for the feet is if deep attachment
kṛṣṇa vinu anyatra tāra nāhi rahe rāga
Kṛṣṇa except elsewhere his not remains attachment

143When deep attachment for Kṛṣṇa’s feet arises, no attachment to anything other than Kṛṣṇa remains.

পঞ্চম পুরুষার্থ সেই প্রেম-মহাধন ৷
কৃষ্ণের মাধুর্য্য-রস করায় আস্বাদন ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

pañcama puruṣārtha sei prema-mahādhana
the fifth goal of life that great treasure of prema
kṛṣṇera mādhurya-rasa karāya āsvādana
Kṛṣṇa’s sweetness-rasa makes taste

144That great treasure of prema is the fifth goal of life; it lets one taste the rasa of Kṛṣṇa’s sweetness.47

প্রেমা হৈতে কৃষ্ণ হয় নিজভক্তবশ ৷
প্রেমা হৈতে পায় কৃষ্ণের সেবা-সুখরস ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

premā haite kṛṣṇa haya nija bhakta-vaśa
prema from Kṛṣṇa becomes to His own devotee subject
premā haite pāya kṛṣṇera sevā-sukha-rasa
prema from one gains Kṛṣṇa’s the joy-rasa of service

145By prema Kṛṣṇa comes under the control of His devotee, and by prema one tastes the joy of serving Kṛṣṇa.

সম্বন্ধ, অভিধেয়, প্রয়োজন-নাম ৷
এই তিন অর্থ সর্ব্বসূত্রে পর্য্যবসান ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

sambandha, abhidheya, prayojana-nāma
sambandha abhidheya prayojana by name
ei tina artha sarva-sūtre paryavasāna
these three meanings in all the sūtras the conclusion

146Sambandha, abhidheya and prayojana — relationship, means and goal: in these three meanings all the sūtras find their conclusion.”48

এইমত সর্ব্বসূত্রের ব্যাখ্যান শুনিয়া ৷
সকল সন্ন্যাসী কহে বিনয় করিয়া ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

ei-mata sarva-sūtrera vyākhyāna śuniyā
in this way of all the sūtras the explanation hearing
sakala sannyāsī kahe vinaya kariyā
all the sannyāsīs say humility showing

147Hearing all the sūtras explained in this way, all the sannyāsīs humbly said:

বেদময়-মূর্ত্তি তুমি, — সাক্ষাৎ নারায়ণ ৷
ক্ষম অপরাধ, — পূর্ব্বে যে কৈলুঁ নিন্দন ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

vedamaya-mūrti tumi, — sākṣāt nārāyaṇa
made of the Vedas the form You directly Nārāyaṇa
kṣama aparādha, — pūrve ye kailum̐ nindana
forgive the offence before which we made blasphemy

148“You are the Vedas embodied — Nārāyaṇa Himself. Forgive us for having blasphemed You before.”

সেই হৈতে সন্ন্যাসীর ফিরে গেল মন ৷
‘কৃষ্ণ’ ‘কৃষ্ণ’ নাম সদা করয়ে গ্রহণ ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

sei haite sannyāsīra phire gela mana
that from of the sannyāsīs turned went the minds
‘kṛṣṇa’ ‘kṛṣṇa’ nāma sadā karaye grahaṇa
‘Kṛṣṇa’ ‘Kṛṣṇa’ the name always they make taking

149From that time the sannyāsīs’ hearts were changed, and they always took the name “Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa”.

এইমতে তাঁ-সবার ক্ষমি’ অপরাধ ৷
সবাকারে কৃষ্ণনাম করিল প্রসাদ ॥ ১৫০ ॥

ei-mate tām̐-sabāra kṣami’ aparādha
in this way of them all forgiving the offences
sabākāre kṛṣṇa-nāma karila prasāda
to all Kṛṣṇa’s name He made grace

150So He forgave their offences and graced them all with Kṛṣṇa’s name.

তবে সকল সন্ন্যাসী মহাপ্রভুকে লৈয়া ৷
ভিক্ষা করিলেন সবে, মধ্যে বসাইয়া ॥ ১৫১ ॥

tabe sakala sannyāsī mahāprabhuke laiyā
then all sannyāsīs Mahāprabhu taking
bhikṣā karilena sabe, madhye vasāiyā
alms took all in the middle seating

151Then all the sannyāsīs took their meal together with Mahāprabhu, seating Him in their midst.

ভিক্ষা করি’ মহাপ্রভু আইলা বাসাঘর ৷
হেন চিত্র লীলা করে গৌরাঙ্গ-সুন্দর ॥ ১৫২ ॥

bhikṣā kari’ mahāprabhu āilā vāsāghara
alms having taken Mahāprabhu came to His lodging
hena citra līlā kare gaurāṅga-sundara
such wonderful pastime performs the beautiful Gaurāṅga

152After the meal Mahāprabhu returned to His lodging. Such are the wonderful pastimes of the beautiful Gaurāṅga.

চন্দ্রশেখর, তপন মিশ্র, আর সনাতন ৷
শুনি’ দেখি’ আনন্দিত সবাকার মন ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

candraśekhara, tapana miśra, āra sanātana
Candraśekhara Tapana Miśra and Sanātana
śuni’ dekhi’ ānandita sabākāra mana
hearing seeing joyful of all the minds

153Candraśekhara, Tapana Miśra and Sanātana rejoiced at heart to hear and see all this.

প্রভুকে দেখিতে আইসে সকল সন্ন্যাসী ৷
প্রভুর প্রশংসা করে সব বারাণসী ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

prabhuke dekhite āise sakala sannyāsī
the Lord to see come all sannyāsīs
prabhura praśaṁsā kare saba vārāṇasī
the Lord’s praise makes all Vārāṇasī

154All the sannyāsīs came to see the Lord, and all Vārāṇasī sang His praises.

বারাণসীপুরী আইলা শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য ৷
পুরীসহ সর্ব্বলোক হৈল মহাধন্য ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

vārāṇasī-purī āilā śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya
to the city of Vārāṇasī came Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya
purī-saha sarva-loka haila mahā-dhanya
with the city all the people became greatly blessed

155Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya had come to Vārāṇasī, and the city and all its people were greatly blessed.

লক্ষ লক্ষ লোক আইসে প্রভুকে দেখিতে ৷
মহাভিড় হৈল দ্বারে, নারে প্রবেশিতে ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

lakṣa lakṣa loka āise prabhuke dekhite
hundreds of thousands of people come the Lord to see
mahā-bhiḍa haila dvāre, nāre praveśite
a great crowd formed at the door they cannot enter

156People came in their hundreds of thousands to see the Lord; there was such a crowd at the door that no one could get in.

প্রভু যবে যা’ন বিশ্বেশ্বর-দরশনে ৷
লক্ষ লক্ষ লোক আসি’ মিলে সেই স্থানে ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

prabhu yabe yā’na viśveśvara-daraśane
the Lord when goes to see Viśveśvara
lakṣa lakṣa loka āsi’ mile sei sthāne
hundreds of thousands of people coming gather at that place

157Whenever the Lord went to see Viśveśvara, hundreds of thousands of people gathered there.

স্নান করিতে যবে যা’ন গঙ্গাতীরে ৷
তাহাঞি সকল লোক হয় মহাভিড়ে ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

snāna karite yabe yā’na gaṅgā-tīre
bath to take when He goes to the bank of the Gaṅgā
tāhāñi sakala loka haya mahā-bhiḍe
there all the people make a great crowd

158When He went to bathe on the bank of the Gaṅgā, there too all the people thronged in a great crowd.

বাহু তুলি’ প্রভু বলে, — বল হরি হরি ৷
হরিধ্বনি করে লোক স্বর্গমর্ত্ত্য ভরি’ ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

bāhu tuli’ prabhu bale, — bala hari hari
arms raising the Lord says say Hari Hari
hari-dhvani kare loka svarga-martya bhari’
the sound of Hari make the people heaven and earth filling

159Raising His arms, the Lord would say, “Chant ‘Hari! Hari!’”, and the people’s cry of “Hari!” filled heaven and earth.

লোক নিস্তারিয়া প্রভুর চলিতে হৈল মন ৷
বৃন্দাবনে পাঠাইলা শ্রীসনাতন ॥ ১৬০ ॥

loka nistāriyā prabhura calite haila mana
the people having delivered the Lord’s to depart came the mind
vṛndāvane pāṭhāilā śrī-sanātana
to Vṛndāvana He sent Śrī Sanātana

160Having delivered the people, the Lord decided to leave, and He sent Śrī Sanātana to Vṛndāvana.

রাত্রি-দিবসে লোকের শুনি’ কোলাহল ৷
বারাণসী ছাড়ি’ প্রভু আইলা নীলাচল ॥ ১৬১ ॥

rātri-divase lokera śuni’ kolāhala
night and day of the people hearing the clamour
vārāṇasī chāḍi’ prabhu āilā nīlācala
Vārāṇasī leaving the Lord came to Nīlācala

161Hearing the clamour of the crowds night and day, the Lord left Vārāṇasī and returned to Nīlācala.

এই লীলা কহিব আগে বিস্তার করিয়া ৷
সংক্ষেপে কহিলাঙ ইহাঁ প্রসঙ্গ পাইয়া ॥ ১৬২ ॥

ei līlā kahiba āge vistāra kariyā
this pastime I shall tell later in detail making
saṅkṣepe kahilāṅa ihām̐ prasaṅga pāiyā
briefly I have told here the occasion finding

162I shall tell these pastimes in detail later; here I have told them briefly, as the occasion arose.49

এই পঞ্চতত্ত্বরূপে শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য ৷
কৃষ্ণ-নাম-প্রেম দিয়া বিশ্ব কৈল ধন্য ॥ ১৬৩ ॥

ei pañca-tattva-rūpe śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya
in this form of the Pañca-tattva Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya
kṛṣṇa-nāma-prema diyā viśva kaila dhanya
Kṛṣṇa’s name and prema giving the world made blessed

163Thus, in the form of the Pañca-tattva, Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya blessed the whole world, giving everyone Kṛṣṇa’s name and love for Him.

মথুরাতে পাঠাইল রূপ-সনাতন ৷
দুই সেনাপতি কৈল ভক্তি প্রচারণ ॥ ১৬৪ ॥

mathurāte pāṭhāila rūpa-sanātana
to Mathurā He sent Rūpa and Sanātana
dui senā-pati kaila bhakti pracāraṇa
the two generals made of bhakti spreading

164He sent Rūpa and Sanātana to Mathurā, and these two commanders spread bhakti there.

নিত্যানন্দ-গোসাঞে পাঠাইলা গৌড়দেশে ৷
তেঁহো ভক্তি প্রচারিলা অশেষ-বিশেষে ॥ ১৬৫ ॥

nityānanda-gosāñe pāṭhāilā gauḍa-deśe
Nityānanda Gosāñi He sent to the land of Gauḍa
tem̐ho bhakti pracārilā aśeṣa-viśeṣe
He bhakti preached in every possible way

165He sent Nityānanda Gosāñi to the land of Gauḍa, and there He preached bhakti in every possible way.

আপনে দক্ষিণ দেশ করিলা গমন ৷
গ্রামে গ্রামে কৈলা কৃষ্ণনাম প্রচারণ ॥ ১৬৬ ॥

āpane dakṣiṇa deśa karilā gamana
Himself to the southern country made going
grāme grāme kailā kṛṣṇa-nāma pracāraṇa
in village in village He made of Kṛṣṇa’s name spreading

166He Himself went to the south and spread Kṛṣṇa’s name from village to village.

সেতুবন্ধ পর্য্যন্ত কৈল ভক্তির প্রচার ৷
কৃষ্ণপ্রেম দিয়া কৈল সবার নিস্তার ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

setubandha paryanta kaila bhaktira pracāra
Setubandha as far as He made of bhakti preaching
kṛṣṇa-prema diyā kaila sabāra nistāra
Kṛṣṇa-prema giving He made of all deliverance

167As far as Setubandha He preached bhakti, and, giving Kṛṣṇa-prema, He delivered everyone.

এই ত’ কহিল পঞ্চতত্ত্বের ব্যাখ্যান ৷
ইহার শ্রবণে হয় চৈতন্যতত্ত্ব-জ্ঞান ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

ei ta’ kahila pañca-tattvera vyākhyāna
thus indeed I have told of the Pañca-tattva the explanation
ihāra śravaṇe haya caitanya-tattva-jñāna
of this by hearing comes of Caitanya’s truth knowledge

168Thus I have given the explanation of the Pañca-tattva; by hearing it one comes to know the truth of Caitanya.

শ্রীচৈতন্য, নিত্যানন্দ, অদ্বৈত, — তিন জন ৷
শ্রীবাস-গদাধর-আদি যত ভক্তগণ ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

śrī-caitanya, nityānanda, advaita, — tina jana
Śrī Caitanya Nityānanda Advaita three persons
śrīvāsa-gadādhara-ādi yata bhakta-gaṇa
Śrīvāsa Gadādhara and others all devotees

169Śrī Caitanya, Nityānanda and Advaita — the three; Śrīvāsa, Gadādhara and all the other devotees —

সবাকার পাদপদ্মে কোটি নমস্কার ৷
যৈছে তৈছে কহি কিছু চৈতন্য-বিহার ॥ ১৭০ ॥

sabākāra pādapadme koṭi namaskāra
of all at the lotus feet millions of obeisances
yaiche taiche kahi kichu caitanya-vihāra
somehow I tell something of Caitanya’s pastimes

170at the lotus feet of all of them I bow millions of times, and as best I can I tell something of Caitanya’s pastimes.

শ্রীরূপ-রঘুনাথ-পদে যার আশ ৷
চৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥ ১৭১ ॥

śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
Śrī Rūpa’s, Raghunātha’s at the feet whose hope
caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
“Caitanya-caritāmṛta” narrates Kṛṣṇadāsa

171Praying at the feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate the Caitanya-caritāmṛta.

✦

Notes

  1. Anubhāṣya: agaty-eka-gati — “the one refuge of those who have no other shelter”; hīnārthādhika-sādhaka — “He who grants to those deprived of the supreme good (paramārtha) something greater still — the fifth goal of life, love for Kṛṣṇa”.
  2. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: in the first chapter the truth of the guru was described — as the initiating and the instructing guru; the six truths are those of the verse vande gurūn īśa-bhaktān (Ādi 1.1), and now the remaining five are examined.
  3. Anubhāṣya: in substance the five truths are one, without duality, but for the sake of the pastimes and the tasting of rasa the one truth is fivefold. The devotee in form, the devotee in essence and the incarnation of a devotee are the Lord Himself, His prakāśa and His aṁśa (viṣṇu-tattva); the potency of devotion and the pure devotee are potencies non-different from Him, who serve Him. Without either the worshipped or the worshipper there would be no pastime of tasting rasa.
  4. According to the Anubhāṣya: the devotee in form is Śrī Gaurāṅga, who tastes His own sweetness; the devotee in essence (in the form of His brother) is Śrī Nityānanda; the devotee-avatāra is Śrī Advaita; the one called a devotee is Śrīvāsa and others, established in śānta, dāsya and the other rasas; the potency is Gadādhara, Svarūpa Dāmodara, Rāmānanda and others. The same verse as Ādi 1.14; ascribed in the edition to Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī.
  5. The edition’s heading: “Though He is the Lord of all, Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya is full of the mood of one who is subordinate.” Anubhāṣya: Śrī Caitanya is the one Supreme Lord of all conscious beings (nityo nityānām…); though non-different from the son of the king of Vraja, He takes a form full of the mood of serving Kṛṣṇa. That form must not be thought of as a body for worldly enjoyment or counted among the jīvas of this world: it is manifest in pure sattva (viśuddha-sattva) and is revealed to a heart illumined by it.
  6. The edition’s heading: “To taste His own sweetness, Kṛṣṇa descends as Gaura — ‘in the form of a devotee’.” Anubhāṣya: Kṛṣṇa, the abode of all sweetness, though He is Himself the object of love (viṣaya), takes on the sentiment of its subject (āśraya) and tastes the joy of serving Himself; yet Śrī Caitanya is not merely a form of the āśraya: He is the original Lord Himself (svayaṁ-rūpa).
  7. Anubhāṣya: Śrī Mahāprabhu is the highest Truth, above all, while Śrī Nityānanda and Śrī Advaita are īśvara-tattvas subordinate to Him; all three are worshipable by everyone else. The fourth truth is the pure devotees, the fifth the intimate (antaraṅga) devotees; both are worshippers. The two worshipable truths, though the last two worship them, are themselves engaged in the service of Śrī Gaurāṅga.
  8. Anubhāṣya: the truths of śakti — the intimate devotees — abide in madhura-rasa, which includes vātsalya, sakhya and dāsya; the servants of Śrī Nityānanda and Śrī Advaita, the pure devotees, usually abide in vātsalya, sakhya, dāsya and śānta. When their love for Śrī Gaurasundara grows intense, they take shelter of madhura-rasa under the guidance of the intimate devotees. Pure devotees are those who, free from other desires, do not cover their service to Kṛṣṇa with karma or jñāna; the intimate devotees are those wholly given to madhura-rasa alone.
  9. Anubhāṣya: “with them” — with all four: with His prakāśa (Śrī Nityānanda), with the avatāra of the Puruṣa (Śrī Advaita), with the intimate devotees and with the pure devotees. The edition’s heading: “With the four truths — the Lord’s pastimes, preaching, tasting and giving.”
  10. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: the storehouse of prema is the pastimes of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. It had come into the world before, but it was locked and sealed; in the descent of Śrī Caitanya the Pañca-tattva broke the seal, threw open the doors and tasted prema, plundering it.
  11. Anubhāṣya: in the Lord’s jīva-śakti, together with the inclination towards Kṛṣṇa, there lies hidden the seed of the desire to enjoy in turning away from Him. As a seed in flooded earth can put forth no shoot, so in the flood of prema the seed of every desire other than service to Kṛṣṇa perished. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: there perished the seed of the bondage of avidyā — the soul’s forgetfulness that it is Kṛṣṇa’s servant.
  12. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: the Māyāvādīs are the sannyāsīs Prakāśānanda and others; those devoted to karma — Devānanda and other karmīs without bhakti, the smārtas, for whom karma and its fruits are the chief goal; the false logicians — Sārvabhauma and other godless logicians; the blasphemers — the one whom the Lord drove away with a stick, Gopāla Cāpāla and others who reviled the Lord and His devotees; the pāṣaṇḍīs — those who place other gods on a level with the Lord; the lowest of students — those for whom learning is only a cause for argument and not a way to God.
  13. Anubhāṣya: Śrī Mahāprabhu accepted sannyāsa in Śaka 1432, in the month of Māgha, during the bright fortnight, at Katwa, from the daṇḍi-svāmī Śrī Keśava Bhāratī of the school of Śrī Śaṅkara (under the Śṛṅgerī Maṭha in the south).
  14. Anubhāṣya: by the rule of the smṛti, a sannyāsī must give up singing, dancing and playing music and always study Vedānta; seeing that Mahāprabhu did not hear Śaṅkara’s Māyāvāda but danced in love, absorbed in singing of Kṛṣṇa, the sannyāsīs of Kāśī took Him to be ignorant of the dharma of sannyāsa.
  15. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: Candraśekhara was a vaidya, and so by varṇa a śūdra. It is not proper for a sannyāsī to spend the night in a śūdra’s house, but Mahāprabhu stayed with him out of mercy, for He is the independent Lord: before His mercy brāhmaṇa and śūdra are equal.
  16. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: wishing to show mercy to the sannyāsīs, the Lord Himself moved the brāhmaṇa’s heart, and so he begged with such insistence.
  17. As in the Gauḍīya Maṭha edition: «কোটীসূর্য্যাভাস» (another reading: «কোটিসূর্য্যাভাস»); the sense is the same.
  18. Anubhāṣya (on 7.149): Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī was then the leader of the sannyāsīs of Śaṅkara’s school in Kāśī. Some mistakenly identify him with Prabodhānanda Sarasvatī, the author of the Caitanya-candrāmṛta and the Rādhā-rasa-sudhā-nidhi, but they are different persons.
  19. Anubhāṣya: of the ten names of sannyāsīs instituted by Śaṅkarācārya, “Tīrtha”, “Āśrama” and “Sarasvatī” are held higher than the rest. Mahāprabhu had taken sannyāsa in the “Bhāratī” line and therefore called Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī’s school the higher one. In this way He showed the humility of a Vaiṣṇava sannyāsī, who seeks no honour for himself and gives honour to others.
  20. Anubhāṣya: Śrī Caitanya, Himself the sole object of the Vedānta, teaches who is fit to study it: one who is humbler than a blade of grass, more tolerant than a tree, who seeks no honour and gives honour to others. In calling Himself a fool, He, the Lord of the fourteen worlds, shows the humility of a disciple; the real fool is one who judges the object of the Vedānta by the mind and senses.
  21. Anubhāṣya (after the Bhakti-sandarbha, 284): the mantras too are names of the Lord, adorned with the word namaḥ and the like, and the sages have placed a special power in them; the name alone, depending on nothing else, is able to give the highest goal of life. Initiation is needed to curb the impure tendencies of those whose minds are attached to the body and restless.
  22. Anubhāṣya: in Satya-yuga the way is meditation, in Tretā sacrifice, in Dvāpara the worship of the Deity; in Kali there is none of these — there is only one way, the name of Hari; all other means are fruitless in Kali.
  23. Anubhāṣya (on 7.74): “Hare Kṛṣṇa Hare Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa Hare Hare / Hare Rāma Hare Rāma Rāma Rāma Hare Hare — these sixteen names destroy the impurity of Kali; no higher means is to be found in all the Vedas” (Kali-santaraṇa Upaniṣad). On 7.83: the mantras of the Pañcarātra are called simply mantras, while the names of the Lord are called the mahā-mantra.
  24. As in the Gauḍīya Maṭha edition: «ব্রহ্মাদি আনন্দ» (“the bliss of Brahman and the rest”; the heading: “Prema, which puts liberation and the rest to shame, is the fifth goal of life”). Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: even the bliss of Brahman, the first stage of liberation, cannot be compared with a single drop of prema. Other editions read «মোক্ষাদি» (“liberation and the rest”).
  25. Anubhāṣya: when those without prema display laughter, tears, dancing and singing, it is only a sign of their misfortune; one who performs bhajana must reject altogether any artificial agitation of body and senses. The laughter, tears, singing, dancing and longing born of bhāva and prema come when the natural function of the soul awakens; they are the guileless movements of one turned towards service. The presumption of one who, without prema, assumes the high station of a devotee brings only harm into the world.
  26. Anubhāṣya: to those whom Gurudeva sees to be qualified he gives the right to dance, sing and perform saṅkīrtana with like-minded devotees, and they, following in his steps, serve the deliverance of the world; the unqualified should chant Kṛṣṇa’s name in solitude.
  27. Anubhāṣya: these words were spoken by Kavi, one of the nine Yogendras, to King Nimi. Evaṁ-vrataḥ — one whose vow is the service of hearing, chanting and the like; druta-cittaḥ — with a heart full of longing; loka-bāhyaḥ — indifferent to people’s laughter, blame or praise.
  28. Anubhāṣya: Śrī Nāma Prabhu Himself, by His own will, moved Śrī Gaurasundara to sing and dance; Gaurasundara did not chant the name as though it were a thing of this world. Those who, driven by restless senses, make the name their plaything and try to lord it over Him, reap only the fruits of karma instead of bhajana.
  29. The edition’s heading to 7.100–101: “Even so — only ordinary regard for bhakti, but firm faith in Māyāvāda.” Anubhāṣya: the Māyāvādīs are pleased when Kṛṣṇa is served with body and mind as a temporary practice, for they consider bhakti a kind of karma; and by “Vedānta” they mean the Upaniṣads and the Brahma-sūtra as interpreted by Śaṅkara.
  30. As in the Gauḍīya Maṭha edition: «তাহা» (“it”; another reading «যাহা», “which”); the sense is the same. Anubhāṣya: the Vedas came into the world from the breath of Śrī Nārāyaṇa; Śrī Vyāsa, who composed the sūtras, is His empowered avatāra (śaktyāveśa), and so the sūtras too are the word of Nārāyaṇa Himself.
  31. The edition’s heading: “In the primary sense (abhidhā) the object of the Vedānta is Bhagavān, the Truth endowed with attributes.” Anubhāṣya: the primary sense (mukhya-vṛtti, abhidhā) is what a word means by dictionary and grammar; the secondary sense (gauṇa-vṛtti, lakṣaṇā) is another meaning connected with it, resorted to out of some need.
  32. The edition’s heading to 7.109: “Hearing Śaṅkara’s commentary, composed in the secondary sense to bewilder the asuras, brings ruin.” Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: Śaṅkara, an avatāra of Śiva, was carrying out the Lord’s will, and therefore he is not at fault. In the Padma Purāṇa Śiva says: “Māyāvāda is a false doctrine, Buddhism in disguise. In the age of Kali I Myself, in the form of a brāhmaṇa, shall set it forth to bewilder the world.”
  33. Anubhāṣya: yayā — “by that conscious potency called the jīva”; dhāryate — “is taken up for one’s own enjoyment”. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intelligence and false ego make up the inferior nature, māyā; the other, superior nature is the jīvas, and māyā has no part in forming the jīva — only its seeming material self belongs to māyā.
  34. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: Viṣṇu’s potency is threefold: the superior (parā) is the spiritual potency (cit-śakti); the kṣetrajña is the jīva potency; that called ignorance and karma is māyā.
  35. The edition’s heading: “To take the Lord, like the jīva, as subject to ignorance is also Māyāvāda.” Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: the jīva is a particular potency of the Lord; if it is established not as a particle of consciousness (aṇu-caitanya) but as Brahman, the doctrine is bound to be mistaken.
  36. The edition’s heading: “The Brahma-sūtra accepts śakti-pariṇāma-vāda, the doctrine of the transformation of the potency.”
  37. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: Śaṅkara argued that by pariṇāma-vāda the Lord would have to be called changeable, and that to accept it would be to call Vyāsa mistaken; so he established vivarta-vāda (in his commentary on Brahma-sūtra 2.1.14). But in the sūtras the transformation is the work of the Lord’s inconceivable potency, acting by His will alone.
  38. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: vivarta is taking a thing for what it is not, “like a rope for a snake”. The jīva is a pure particle of spirit, and when, embodied as a human being, it takes this body for its self, that is vivarta. To transfer this fault to the world and to the jīva, calling them false, is groundless: both the world and the jīva are real, coming from the real Brahman.
  39. The edition’s heading to 7.127: “Though His potency is transformed, He Himself remains unchanged.” Anubhāṣya (after Śrī Jīva Gosvāmī’s Paramātma-sandarbha, 58): it is not the essence (svarūpa) of the Supreme that is transformed but His potency called dravya, which is the expansion of His essence; He Himself, by His inconceivable potency, remains unchanged, like the cintāmaṇi or the lodestone, which, without changing, produce jewels or move iron. The world therefore is not false: what is false is only the identification of the self with the body.
  40. Anubhāṣya: oṁ, the praṇava, is the great utterance, the source of the Vedas; it stands at the beginning and at the end of every Vedic mantra and is the Lord Himself in sound: “The sound a denotes Kṛṣṇa, the one Lord of all the worlds; u denotes Rādhā; and m the jīva.”
  41. The edition’s heading: “The Lord is the denoted, the praṇava the denoting; tat tvam asi and the like point only to one part of the Veda.” Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: a great utterance (mahā-vākya) is one that embraces the whole Veda; tat tvam asi (Chāndogya Upaniṣad 6.8.7) applies only to one part of it.
  42. Anubhāṣya: “In the Vedas, in the Rāmāyaṇa, in the Purāṇas and in the Mahābhārata — at the beginning, in the middle and at the end — Hari alone is sung everywhere.”
  43. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: “O Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, the reasoning by which You have refuted Śaṅkara’s meaning is no idle quarrel: a fortunate person accepts it as the truth.”
  44. The edition’s heading: “The Lord’s explanation: (1) Bhagavān Kṛṣṇa is the sambandha.” Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: in the Bṛhad-āraṇyaka Upaniṣad (pūrṇam adaḥ…, 5.1) the Supreme Truth, full of the six opulences, is called “the great reality”; the Purāṇas describe the same marks by the word “Bhagavān”. So wherever the Vedas say “Brahman”, the word fulfils its meaning when it is understood as Śrī Bhagavān.
  45. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: Bhagavān, embracing the featureless aspect within Himself, is eternally endowed with attributes; to call Him featureless is not to accept His cit-śakti. Brahman possesses spiritual potency and is therefore personal; one who does not accept half of His being diminishes His fullness.
  46. The edition’s heading to 7.141: “(2) Sādhana-bhakti, beginning with hearing, is the means — the abhidheya.” Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: to attain the shelter of Bhagavān’s feet, all the Vedas prescribe sādhana-bhakti; from its nine forms, beginning with hearing, Kṛṣṇa-prema springs up.
  47. The edition’s heading to 7.143: “(3) Kṛṣṇa-prema is the goal (prayojana), the fifth aim of life.”
  48. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: knowledge of sambandha is the answer to the questions: who am I, what is this world, who is Bhagavān and what is our relationship; abhidheya is what one must do, having learned this; prayojana is the fruit of that endeavour. Anubhāṣya (on 7.106): the first two chapters of the Vedānta-sūtra speak of sambandha, the third of abhidheya, sādhana-bhakti, the fourth of prayojana, love for Bhagavān; the natural commentary on the sūtras, written by Vyāsa himself, is the Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.
  49. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: “later” — see Madhya-līlā, chapter 25.
